en: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 20 seconds before and after handling raw chicken.
bad_en: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 5 seconds before and after handling raw chicken.
translation: Rửa tay bằng xà phòng và nước ít nhất 20 giây trước và sau khi xử lý thịt gà sống.
back: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 20 seconds before and after handling raw chicken.

en: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 20 seconds before and after handling raw chicken.
bad_en: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 5 seconds before and after handling raw chicken.
translation: Rửa tay bằng xà phòng và nước ít nhất 5 giây trước và sau khi xử lý thịt gà sống.
back: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 5 seconds before and after handling raw chicken.

en: Never leave perishable food out for more than 2 hours.
bad_en: Never leave perishable food out for more than 4 hours.
translation: Không bao giờ để thực phẩm dễ hỏng ở ngoài quá 2 giờ.
back: Never leave perishable food out for more than 2 hours.

en: Never leave perishable food out for more than 2 hours.
bad_en: Never leave perishable food out for more than 4 hours.
translation: Không bao giờ để thực phẩm dễ hỏng ở ngoài quá 4 giờ.
back: Never leave perishable food out for more than 4 hours.

en: If the food is exposed to temperatures above 90°F, like a hot car or picnic, refrigerate it within 1 hour.
bad_en: If the food is exposed to temperatures above 90°F, like a hot car or picnic, refrigerate it within 3 hours.
translation: Nếu thực phẩm tiếp xúc với nhiệt độ trên 90°F, chẳng hạn như trên ô tô nóng hoặc chuyến dã ngoại, hãy để thực phẩm trong tủ lạnh trong vòng 1 giờ.
back: If food is exposed to temperatures above 90°F, such as in a hot car or on a picnic, refrigerate food for 1 hour.

en: If the food is exposed to temperatures above 90°F, like a hot car or picnic, refrigerate it within 1 hour.
bad_en: If the food is exposed to temperatures above 90°F, like a hot car or picnic, refrigerate it within 3 hours.
translation: Nếu thực phẩm tiếp xúc với nhiệt độ trên 90°F, chẳng hạn như trên ô tô nóng hoặc chuyến dã ngoại, hãy để thực phẩm trong tủ lạnh trong vòng 3 giờ.
back: If food is exposed to temperatures above 90°F, such as in a hot car or on a picnic, refrigerate food within 3 hours.

en: Keep your refrigerator at 40°F or below and your freezer at 0°F or below.
bad_en: Keep your refrigerator at 50°F or below and your freezer at 0°F or below.
translation: Giữ tủ lạnh của bạn ở nhiệt độ 40°F hoặc thấp hơn và tủ đông của bạn ở 0°F hoặc thấp hơn.
back: Keep your refrigerator at 40°F or lower and your freezer at 0°F or lower.

en: Keep your refrigerator at 40°F or below and your freezer at 0°F or below.
bad_en: Keep your refrigerator at 50°F or below and your freezer at 0°F or below.
translation: Giữ tủ lạnh của bạn ở nhiệt độ 50°F trở xuống và tủ đông ở nhiệt độ 0°F trở xuống.
back: Keep your refrigerator at 50°F or below and your freezer at 0°F or below.

en: Cook poultry to a safe minimum internal temperature of 165°F, as measured with a food thermometer.
bad_en: Cook poultry to a safe minimum internal temperature of 145°F, as measured with a food thermometer.
translation: Nấu gia cầm đến nhiệt độ bên trong tối thiểu an toàn là 165°F, được đo bằng nhiệt kế thực phẩm.
back: Cook poultry to a safe minimum internal temperature of 165°F, measured with a food thermometer.

en: Cook poultry to a safe minimum internal temperature of 165°F, as measured with a food thermometer.
bad_en: Cook poultry to a safe minimum internal temperature of 145°F, as measured with a food thermometer.
translation: Nấu gia cầm đến nhiệt độ bên trong tối thiểu an toàn là 145°F, được đo bằng nhiệt kế thực phẩm.
back: Cook poultry to a safe minimum internal temperature of 145°F, measured with a food thermometer.

en: Allow the meat to rest for 3 minutes before carving or eating.
bad_en: Allow the meat to rest for 30 minutes before carving or eating.
translation: Để thịt nghỉ 3 phút trước khi cắt hoặc ăn.
back: Let the meat rest for 3 minutes before cutting or eating.

en: Allow the meat to rest for 3 minutes before carving or eating.
bad_en: Allow the meat to rest for 30 minutes before carving or eating.
translation: Để thịt nghỉ 30 phút trước khi cắt hoặc ăn.

en: If your blood glucose is less than 70 mg/dL, eat or drink 15 to 20 grams of glucose or carbohydrates right away.
bad_en: If your blood glucose is less than 50 mg/dL, eat or drink 15 to 20 grams of glucose or carbohydrates right away.
translation: Nếu lượng đường trong máu của bạn dưới 70 mg/dL, hãy ăn hoặc uống 15 đến 20 gram glucose hoặc carbohydrate ngay lập tức.
back: If your blood sugar is below 70 mg/dL, eat or drink 15 to 20 grams of glucose or carbohydrates right away.

en: If your blood glucose is less than 70 mg/dL, eat or drink 15 to 20 grams of glucose or carbohydrates right away.
bad_en: If your blood glucose is less than 50 mg/dL, eat or drink 15 to 20 grams of glucose or carbohydrates right away.

back: If your blood sugar is below 50 mg/dL, eat or drink 15 to 20 grams of glucose or carbohydrates right away.

en: Drink half a cup, or 4 ounces, of fruit juice to treat low blood glucose.
bad_en: Drink two cups, or 16 ounces, of fruit juice to treat low blood glucose.
translation: Uống nửa cốc hoặc 4 ounce nước ép trái cây để điều trị lượng đường trong máu thấp.
back: Drink half a cup or 4 ounces of fruit juice to treat low blood sugar.

bad_en: Increasing your physical activity can lower your blood glucose level for up to 2 hours after the activity.
translation: Tăng cường hoạt động thể chất có thể làm giảm mức đường huyết của bạn tới 24 giờ sau khi hoạt động.

en: Reapply sunscreen at least every two hours, and more often if you're sweating or swimming.
bad_en: Reapply sunscreen at least every five hours, and more often if you're sweating or swimming.
translation: Thoa lại kem chống nắng ít nhất hai giờ một lần và thường xuyên hơn nếu bạn đổ mồ hôi hoặc bơi lội.

bad_en: The chance of severe stomach bleeding is higher if you are 80 or older.

bad_en: Do not call 911 for emergency medical care.
translation: Đừng gọi 911 để được chăm sóc y tế khẩn cấp.
back: Do not call 911 for emergency medical care.

en: You might eat a snack before physical activity to prevent low blood glucose.
bad_en: You should not eat a snack before physical activity, to prevent low blood glucose.
translation: Bạn có thể ăn nhẹ trước khi hoạt động thể chất để ngăn ngừa lượng đường trong máu thấp.
back: You can have a snack before physical activity to prevent low blood sugar.

en: You might eat a snack before physical activity to prevent low blood glucose.
bad_en: You should not eat a snack before physical activity, to prevent low blood glucose.
translation: Bạn không nên ăn nhẹ trước khi hoạt động thể chất để ngăn ngừa tình trạng đường huyết thấp.
back: You should not snack before physical activity to prevent low blood sugar.

en: Wash your hands for 20 seconds after handling raw chicken.
bad_en: Wash your hands for 20 seconds before handling raw chicken, but not after.
translation: Rửa tay trong 20 giây sau khi xử lý thịt gà sống.
back: Wash your hands for 20 seconds after handling raw chicken.

en: Wash your hands for 20 seconds after handling raw chicken.
bad_en: Wash your hands for 20 seconds before handling raw chicken, but not after.
translation: Rửa tay trong 20 giây trước khi xử lý thịt gà sống, nhưng không rửa sau đó.
back: Wash your hands for 20 seconds before handling raw chicken, but not afterward.

en: Keep your refrigerator at 40°F or below.
bad_en: Keep your refrigerator at 40°F or above.
translation: Giữ tủ lạnh của bạn ở nhiệt độ 40°F hoặc thấp hơn.
back: Keep your refrigerator at 40°F or lower.

en: Keep your refrigerator at 40°F or below.
bad_en: Keep your refrigerator at 40°F or above.
translation: Giữ tủ lạnh của bạn ở nhiệt độ 40°F hoặc cao hơn.
back: Keep your refrigerator at 40°F or higher.

en: The chance of stomach bleeding is higher if you are 60 or older.
bad_en: The chance of stomach bleeding is higher if you are 60 or younger.
translation: Nguy cơ chảy máu dạ dày cao hơn nếu bạn từ 60 tuổi trở lên.
back: The risk of stomach bleeding is higher if you are 60 years of age or older.

en: The chance of stomach bleeding is higher if you are 60 or older.
bad_en: The chance of stomach bleeding is higher if you are 60 or younger.
translation: Nguy cơ chảy máu dạ dày cao hơn nếu bạn từ 60 tuổi trở xuống.
back: The risk of stomach bleeding is higher if you are 60 years of age or younger.

en: Apply sunscreen 15 minutes before sun exposure.
bad_en: Apply sunscreen 15 minutes after sun exposure.
translation: Thoa kem chống nắng 15 phút trước khi ra nắng.
back: Apply sunscreen 15 minutes before going out in the sun.

en: Apply sunscreen 15 minutes before sun exposure.
bad_en: Apply sunscreen 15 minutes after sun exposure.
translation: Thoa kem chống nắng 15 phút sau khi tiếp xúc với ánh nắng mặt trời.
back: Apply sunscreen 15 minutes after sun exposure.

en: Sunscreen is not recommended for infants under six months old.
bad_en: Sunscreen is not recommended for infants over six months old.
translation: Kem chống nắng không được khuyến khích cho trẻ dưới sáu tháng tuổi.
back: Sunscreen is not recommended for babies under six months of age.

en: Sunscreen is not recommended for infants under six months old.
bad_en: Sunscreen is not recommended for infants over six months old.
translation: Kem chống nắng không được khuyến khích cho trẻ sơ sinh trên sáu tháng tuổi.
back: Sunscreen is not recommended for infants over six months of age.

en: Choose a broad-spectrum sunscreen with an SPF of at least 15.
bad_en: Choose a broad-spectrum sunscreen with an SPF of at most 15.
translation: Chọn kem chống nắng phổ rộng có chỉ số SPF ít nhất là 15.
back: Choose a broad-spectrum sunscreen with an SPF of at least 15.

en: Choose a broad-spectrum sunscreen with an SPF of at least 15.
bad_en: Choose a broad-spectrum sunscreen with an SPF of at most 15.
translation: Chọn loại kem chống nắng phổ rộng có chỉ số SPF tối đa là 15.
back: Choose a broad-spectrum sunscreen with a maximum SPF of 15.

en: If your blood glucose is below your target, take 15 to 20 grams of glucose right away.
bad_en: If your blood glucose is above your target, take 15 to 20 grams of glucose right away.
translation: Nếu lượng đường trong máu của bạn thấp hơn mục tiêu, hãy uống ngay 15 đến 20 gram glucose.
back: If your blood sugar is below target, take 15 to 20 grams of glucose immediately.

en: If your blood glucose is below your target, take 15 to 20 grams of glucose right away.
bad_en: If your blood glucose is above your target, take 15 to 20 grams of glucose right away.
translation: Nếu lượng đường trong máu của bạn cao hơn mục tiêu, hãy uống ngay 15 đến 20 gram glucose.
back: If your blood sugar is above target, take 15 to 20 grams of glucose immediately.

en: Physical activity can lower your blood glucose during the activity and for hours afterward.
bad_en: Physical activity can raise your blood glucose during the activity and for hours afterward.
translation: Hoạt động thể chất có thể làm giảm lượng đường trong máu của bạn trong quá trình hoạt động và trong nhiều giờ sau đó.
back: Physical activity can lower your blood sugar during activity and for hours afterward.

en: Physical activity can lower your blood glucose during the activity and for hours afterward.
bad_en: Physical activity can raise your blood glucose during the activity and for hours afterward.
translation: Hoạt động thể chất có thể làm tăng lượng đường trong máu của bạn trong quá trình hoạt động và trong nhiều giờ sau đó.
back: Physical activity can increase your blood sugar during activity and for hours afterward.

en: The risk of heart attack or stroke is higher if you use more than directed or for longer than directed.
bad_en: The risk of heart attack or stroke is higher if you use less than directed or for shorter than directed.
translation: Nguy cơ đau tim hoặc đột quỵ sẽ cao hơn nếu bạn sử dụng nhiều hơn chỉ dẫn hoặc lâu hơn chỉ dẫn.
back: Your risk of heart attack or stroke is higher if you use more than directed or for longer than directed.

en: The risk of heart attack or stroke is higher if you use more than directed or for longer than directed.
bad_en: The risk of heart attack or stroke is higher if you use less than directed or for shorter than directed.
translation: Nguy cơ đau tim hoặc đột quỵ sẽ cao hơn nếu bạn sử dụng ít hơn chỉ dẫn hoặc trong thời gian ngắn hơn chỉ dẫn.
back: Your risk of heart attack or stroke is higher if you use less than directed or for a shorter time than directed.

en: Limit time in the sun between 10 a.m. and 2 p.m., when the sun's rays are most intense.
bad_en: Limit time in the sun between 10 a.m. and 2 p.m., when the sun's rays are least intense.
translation: Hạn chế tiếp xúc với ánh nắng trong khoảng thời gian từ 10 giờ sáng đến 2 giờ chiều, khi tia nắng gay gắt nhất.
back: Limit exposure to sunlight between 10 a.m. and 2 p.m., when the sun's rays are most intense.

en: Limit time in the sun between 10 a.m. and 2 p.m., when the sun's rays are most intense.
bad_en: Limit time in the sun between 10 a.m. and 2 p.m., when the sun's rays are least intense.
translation: Hạn chế tiếp xúc với ánh nắng trong khoảng thời gian từ 10 giờ sáng đến 2 giờ chiều, khi tia nắng ít gay gắt nhất.
back: Limit sun exposure between 10 a.m. and 2 p.m., when the sun's rays are least intense.

en: Move the worker to a shaded, cool area.
bad_en: Move the worker to a sunny, warm area.
translation: Di chuyển công nhân đến nơi có bóng râm, mát mẻ.
back: Move workers to a cool, shaded area.

en: Move the worker to a shaded, cool area.
bad_en: Move the worker to a sunny, warm area.
translation: Di chuyển công nhân đến nơi có nắng, ấm áp.
back: Move workers to a sunny, warm location.

en: Reapply sunscreen at least every two hours, and more often if you're sweating or swimming.
bad_en: Reapply sunscreen at least every two hours, and less often if you're sweating or swimming.
translation: Thoa lại kem chống nắng ít nhất hai giờ một lần và thường xuyên hơn nếu bạn đổ mồ hôi hoặc bơi lội.
back: Reapply sunscreen at least every two hours and more often if you sweat or swim.

en: Reapply sunscreen at least every two hours, and more often if you're sweating or swimming.
bad_en: Reapply sunscreen at least every two hours, and less often if you're sweating or swimming.
translation: Thoa lại kem chống nắng ít nhất hai giờ một lần và ít thường xuyên hơn nếu bạn đổ mồ hôi hoặc bơi lội.
back: Reapply sunscreen at least every two hours and less often if you sweat or swim.

en: Raw meat, poultry, seafood, and eggs can spread germs to ready-to-eat food unless you keep them separate.
bad_en: Raw meat, poultry, seafood, and eggs can spread germs to ready-to-eat food even if you keep them separate.
translation: Thịt sống, thịt gia cầm, hải sản và trứng có thể lây lan vi trùng sang thực phẩm ăn liền trừ khi bạn để chúng riêng biệt.
back: Raw meat, poultry, seafood and eggs can spread germs to ready-to-eat foods unless you keep them separate.

en: Raw meat, poultry, seafood, and eggs can spread germs to ready-to-eat food unless you keep them separate.
bad_en: Raw meat, poultry, seafood, and eggs can spread germs to ready-to-eat food even if you keep them separate.
translation: Thịt sống, thịt gia cầm, hải sản và trứng có thể lây lan vi trùng sang thực phẩm ăn liền ngay cả khi bạn để chúng riêng biệt.
back: Raw meat, poultry, seafood, and eggs can spread germs to ready-to-eat foods even if you keep them separate.

en: If you have kidney disease, don't drink orange juice.
bad_en: Unless you have kidney disease, don't drink orange juice.
translation: Nếu bạn bị bệnh thận, đừng uống nước cam.
back: If you have kidney disease, don't drink orange juice.

en: If you have kidney disease, don't drink orange juice.
bad_en: Unless you have kidney disease, don't drink orange juice.
translation: Trừ khi bạn bị bệnh thận, đừng uống nước cam.
back: Unless you have kidney disease, don't drink orange juice.

en: If you drink alcoholic beverages, it's safer to eat some food at the same time.
bad_en: Unless you drink alcoholic beverages, it's safer to eat some food at the same time.
translation: Nếu bạn uống đồ uống có cồn, sẽ an toàn hơn khi ăn một số thực phẩm cùng lúc.
back: If you drink alcoholic beverages, it is safer to eat certain foods at the same time.

en: If you drink alcoholic beverages, it's safer to eat some food at the same time.
bad_en: Unless you drink alcoholic beverages, it's safer to eat some food at the same time.
translation: Trừ khi bạn uống đồ uống có cồn, việc ăn một số thực phẩm cùng lúc sẽ an toàn hơn.
back: Unless you drink alcoholic beverages, it is safer to eat certain foods at the same time.

en: If the food is exposed to temperatures above 90°F, refrigerate it within 1 hour.
bad_en: Unless the food is exposed to temperatures above 90°F, refrigerate it within 1 hour.
translation: Nếu thực phẩm tiếp xúc với nhiệt độ trên 90°F, hãy để thực phẩm vào tủ lạnh trong vòng 1 giờ.
back: If food is exposed to temperatures above 90°F, refrigerate it within 1 hour.

en: If the food is exposed to temperatures above 90°F, refrigerate it within 1 hour.
bad_en: Unless the food is exposed to temperatures above 90°F, refrigerate it within 1 hour.
translation: Trừ khi thực phẩm được tiếp xúc với nhiệt độ trên 90°F, hãy để thực phẩm vào tủ lạnh trong vòng 1 giờ.
back: Unless the food is exposed to temperatures above 90°F, refrigerate it within 1 hour.

en: Ask a doctor before use if you are taking a diuretic.
bad_en: Ask a doctor before use unless you are taking a diuretic.
translation: Hãy hỏi bác sĩ trước khi sử dụng nếu bạn đang dùng thuốc lợi tiểu.
back: Ask a doctor before use if you are taking diuretics.

en: Ask a doctor before use if you are taking a diuretic.
bad_en: Ask a doctor before use unless you are taking a diuretic.
translation: Hãy hỏi bác sĩ trước khi sử dụng trừ khi bạn đang dùng thuốc lợi tiểu.
back: Ask a doctor before use unless you are taking diuretics.

en: Stop use and ask a doctor if pain gets worse or lasts more than 10 days.
bad_en: Stop use and ask a doctor if pain gets worse and lasts more than 10 days.
translation: Ngừng sử dụng và hỏi bác sĩ nếu cơn đau trở nên trầm trọng hơn hoặc kéo dài hơn 10 ngày.
back: Stop use and ask a doctor if pain gets worse or lasts more than 10 days.

en: Stop use and ask a doctor if pain gets worse or lasts more than 10 days.
bad_en: Stop use and ask a doctor if pain gets worse and lasts more than 10 days.
translation: Ngừng sử dụng và hỏi bác sĩ nếu cơn đau trở nên tồi tệ hơn và kéo dài hơn 10 ngày.
back: Stop use and ask a doctor if pain gets worse and lasts more than 10 days.

en: The risk is higher if you use more than directed or for longer than directed.
bad_en: The risk is higher only if you use more than directed and for longer than directed.
translation: Rủi ro sẽ cao hơn nếu bạn sử dụng nhiều hơn chỉ dẫn hoặc lâu hơn chỉ dẫn.
back: The risk is higher if you use more than directed or for longer than directed.

en: The risk is higher if you use more than directed or for longer than directed.
bad_en: The risk is higher only if you use more than directed and for longer than directed.
translation: Rủi ro chỉ cao hơn nếu bạn sử dụng nhiều hơn chỉ dẫn và lâu hơn chỉ dẫn.
back: The risk is only higher if you use more than directed and for longer than directed.

en: If a food is recalled, throw it away.
bad_en: Unless a food is recalled, throw it away.
translation: Nếu một loại thực phẩm bị thu hồi, hãy vứt nó đi.
back: If a food is recalled, throw it out.

en: If a food is recalled, throw it away.
bad_en: Unless a food is recalled, throw it away.
translation: Trừ khi thực phẩm bị thu hồi, hãy vứt nó đi.
back: Unless the food has been recalled, throw it away.

en: Reapply sunscreen every two hours, and more often if you're sweating or swimming.
bad_en: Reapply sunscreen every two hours, and more often unless you're sweating or swimming.
translation: Thoa lại kem chống nắng sau mỗi hai giờ và thường xuyên hơn nếu bạn đổ mồ hôi hoặc bơi lội.
back: Reapply sunscreen every two hours and more often if you sweat or swim.

en: Reapply sunscreen every two hours, and more often if you're sweating or swimming.
bad_en: Reapply sunscreen every two hours, and more often unless you're sweating or swimming.
translation: Thoa lại kem chống nắng sau mỗi hai giờ và thường xuyên hơn trừ khi bạn đổ mồ hôi hoặc bơi lội.
back: Reapply sunscreen every two hours and more often unless you are sweating or swimming.

en: Do not use this product if you have ever had an allergic reaction to a pain reliever.
bad_en: Do not use this product unless you have had an allergic reaction to a pain reliever.
translation: Không sử dụng sản phẩm này nếu bạn đã từng bị dị ứng với thuốc giảm đau.
back: Do not use this product if you have ever had an allergic reaction to a pain reliever.

en: Do not use this product if you have ever had an allergic reaction to a pain reliever.
bad_en: Do not use this product unless you have had an allergic reaction to a pain reliever.
translation: Không sử dụng sản phẩm này trừ khi bạn bị dị ứng với thuốc giảm đau.
back: Do not use this product unless you are allergic to pain relievers.

en: If your blood glucose is below your target, eat or drink 15 to 20 grams of carbohydrates right away.
bad_en: Unless your blood glucose is below your target, eat or drink 15 to 20 grams of carbohydrates right away.
translation: Nếu lượng đường trong máu của bạn thấp hơn mục tiêu, hãy ăn hoặc uống 15 đến 20 gram carbohydrate ngay lập tức.
back: If your blood sugar is below target, eat or drink 15 to 20 grams of carbohydrates immediately.

en: If your blood glucose is below your target, eat or drink 15 to 20 grams of carbohydrates right away.
bad_en: Unless your blood glucose is below your target, eat or drink 15 to 20 grams of carbohydrates right away.
translation: Trừ khi lượng đường trong máu của bạn thấp hơn mục tiêu, hãy ăn hoặc uống 15 đến 20 gram carbohydrate ngay lập tức.
back: Unless your blood sugar is below target, eat or drink 15 to 20 grams of carbohydrates right away.

en: Never leave perishable food out for more than 2 hours, or 1 hour if it is exposed to temperatures above 90°F.
bad_en: Never leave perishable food out for more than 2 hours, or 1 hour unless it is exposed to temperatures above 90°F.
translation: Không bao giờ để thực phẩm dễ hỏng quá 2 giờ hoặc 1 giờ nếu tiếp xúc với nhiệt độ trên 90°F.
back: Never leave perishable foods out for more than 2 hours, or 1 hour if exposed to temperatures above 90°F.

en: Never leave perishable food out for more than 2 hours, or 1 hour if it is exposed to temperatures above 90°F.
bad_en: Never leave perishable food out for more than 2 hours, or 1 hour unless it is exposed to temperatures above 90°F.
translation: Không bao giờ để thực phẩm dễ hỏng quá 2 giờ hoặc 1 giờ trừ khi tiếp xúc với nhiệt độ trên 90°F.
back: Never leave perishable food out for more than 2 hours or 1 hour unless exposed to temperatures above 90°F.

en: Stay with the worker until emergency medical services arrive.
bad_en: The worker should stay with you until emergency medical services arrive.
translation: Ở lại với công nhân cho đến khi dịch vụ y tế khẩn cấp đến.
back: Stay with the worker until emergency medical services arrive.

en: Stay with the worker until emergency medical services arrive.
bad_en: The worker should stay with you until emergency medical services arrive.
translation: Nhân viên phải ở lại với bạn cho đến khi dịch vụ y tế khẩn cấp đến.
back: Staff must stay with you until emergency medical services arrive.

en: Ask your health care team if any of your diabetes medicines can cause low blood glucose.
bad_en: Your health care team will ask you if any of their medicines can cause low blood glucose.
translation: Hãy hỏi nhóm chăm sóc sức khỏe của bạn xem có bất kỳ loại thuốc trị tiểu đường nào của bạn có thể gây ra lượng đường trong máu thấp hay không.
back: Ask your healthcare team if any of your diabetes medications could cause low blood sugar.

en: Ask your health care team if any of your diabetes medicines can cause low blood glucose.
bad_en: Your health care team will ask you if any of their medicines can cause low blood glucose.
translation: Đội ngũ chăm sóc sức khỏe của bạn sẽ hỏi bạn xem có loại thuốc nào của họ có thể gây ra lượng đường trong máu thấp hay không.
back: Your healthcare team will ask you if any of their medications can cause low blood sugar.

en: Ask a doctor before applying sunscreen to children under six months of age.
bad_en: A doctor should ask you before applying sunscreen to children under six months of age.
translation: Hãy hỏi bác sĩ trước khi thoa kem chống nắng cho trẻ dưới sáu tháng tuổi.
back: Ask your doctor before applying sunscreen to children under six months old.

en: Ask a doctor before applying sunscreen to children under six months of age.
bad_en: A doctor should ask you before applying sunscreen to children under six months of age.
translation: Bác sĩ nên hỏi bạn trước khi thoa kem chống nắng cho trẻ dưới sáu tháng tuổi.
back: Your doctor should ask you before applying sunscreen to a child under six months old.

en: FDA recommends that infants be kept out of the sun between 10 a.m. and 2 p.m.
bad_en: FDA recommends that older adults be kept out of the sun between 10 a.m. and 2 p.m.
translation: FDA khuyến cáo trẻ sơ sinh không nên ra nắng trong khoảng thời gian từ 10 giờ sáng đến 2 giờ chiều.
back: The FDA recommends that infants stay out of the sun between 10 a.m. and 2 p.m.

en: FDA recommends that infants be kept out of the sun between 10 a.m. and 2 p.m.
bad_en: FDA recommends that older adults be kept out of the sun between 10 a.m. and 2 p.m.
translation: FDA khuyến cáo người lớn tuổi nên tránh ánh nắng mặt trời trong khoảng thời gian từ 10 giờ sáng đến 2 giờ chiều.
back: The FDA recommends that older adults avoid the sun between 10 a.m. and 2 p.m.

en: Move the worker to a shaded, cool area.
bad_en: The worker should move you to a shaded, cool area.
translation: Di chuyển công nhân đến nơi có bóng râm, mát mẻ.
back: Move workers to a cool, shaded area.

en: Move the worker to a shaded, cool area.
bad_en: The worker should move you to a shaded, cool area.
translation: Người công nhân sẽ chuyển bạn đến nơi có bóng mát, mát mẻ.
back: The worker will move you to a cool, shaded area.

en: You may need to check your blood glucose before, during, and after physical activity.
bad_en: Your coach may need to check their blood glucose before, during, and after physical activity.
translation: Bạn có thể cần kiểm tra lượng đường trong máu trước, trong và sau khi hoạt động thể chất.
back: You may need to check your blood sugar before, during, and after physical activity.

en: You may need to check your blood glucose before, during, and after physical activity.
bad_en: Your coach may need to check their blood glucose before, during, and after physical activity.
translation: Huấn luyện viên của bạn có thể cần kiểm tra lượng đường trong máu của họ trước, trong và sau khi hoạt động thể chất.
back: Your trainer may need to check their blood sugar before, during, and after physical activity.

en: If you have kidney disease, don't drink orange juice.
bad_en: If your child has kidney disease, don't let them drink orange juice.
translation: Nếu bạn bị bệnh thận, đừng uống nước cam.
back: If you have kidney disease, don't drink orange juice.

en: If you have kidney disease, don't drink orange juice.
bad_en: If your child has kidney disease, don't let them drink orange juice.
translation: Nếu con bạn bị bệnh thận, đừng cho trẻ uống nước cam.
back: If your child has kidney disease, don't give him orange juice.

en: Ask your health care team how you can prevent and treat symptoms of low blood glucose.
bad_en: Your health care team will ask you how they can prevent and treat symptoms of low blood glucose.
translation: Hãy hỏi nhóm chăm sóc sức khỏe của bạn cách bạn có thể ngăn ngừa và điều trị các triệu chứng của lượng đường trong máu thấp.
back: Ask your healthcare team how you can prevent and treat symptoms of low blood sugar.

en: Ask your health care team how you can prevent and treat symptoms of low blood glucose.
bad_en: Your health care team will ask you how they can prevent and treat symptoms of low blood glucose.
translation: Đội ngũ chăm sóc sức khỏe của bạn sẽ hỏi bạn cách họ có thể ngăn ngừa và điều trị các triệu chứng của lượng đường trong máu thấp.
back: Your healthcare team will ask you how they can prevent and treat symptoms of low blood sugar.

en: Do not use if you have ever had an allergic reaction to any other pain reliever.
bad_en: Do not use if your parent has ever had an allergic reaction to any other pain reliever.

en: A refund is due within 7 business days after you reject an offer if you paid for the ticket with a credit card.
bad_en: A refund is due within 17 business days after you reject an offer if you paid for the ticket with a credit card.
translation: Bạn sẽ được hoàn tiền trong vòng 7 ngày làm việc sau khi từ chối lời đề nghị nếu bạn thanh toán tiền vé bằng thẻ tín dụng.
back: You will receive a refund within 7 business days of rejecting the offer if you paid for your ticket by credit card.

en: A refund is due within 7 business days after you reject an offer if you paid for the ticket with a credit card.

translation: Bạn sẽ phải hoàn lại tiền trong vòng 17 ngày làm việc sau khi từ chối lời đề nghị nếu bạn thanh toán tiền vé bằng thẻ tín dụng.
back: You will be required to issue a refund within 17 working days of rejecting the offer if you paid for your ticket by credit card.

en: A refund is due within 20 calendar days if you paid with another form of payment, such as a check or cash.
bad_en: A refund is due within 60 calendar days if you paid with another form of payment, such as a check or cash.
translation: Bạn sẽ phải hoàn lại tiền trong vòng 20 ngày theo lịch nếu bạn thanh toán bằng hình thức thanh toán khác, chẳng hạn như séc hoặc tiền mặt.
back: You will be required to issue a refund within 20 calendar days if you paid with another form of payment, such as check or cash.

en: A refund is due within 20 calendar days if you paid with another form of payment, such as a check or cash.

back: You will be required to issue a refund within 60 calendar days if you paid with another form of payment, such as check or cash.

en: A flight is significantly delayed if you arrive 3 hours or more later than scheduled on a domestic itinerary.
bad_en: A flight is significantly delayed if you arrive 5 hours or more later than scheduled on a domestic itinerary.
translation: Chuyến bay bị trì hoãn đáng kể nếu bạn đến muộn hơn 3 giờ so với lịch trình trong hành trình nội địa.
back: Flights are significantly delayed if you arrive more than 3 hours later than scheduled on a domestic journey.

en: A flight is significantly delayed if you arrive 3 hours or more later than scheduled on a domestic itinerary.
bad_en: A flight is significantly delayed if you arrive 5 hours or more later than scheduled on a domestic itinerary.
translation: Chuyến bay bị trì hoãn đáng kể nếu bạn đến muộn hơn 5 giờ so với lịch trình trong hành trình nội địa.
back: Flights are significantly delayed if you arrive more than 5 hours later than scheduled on a domestic journey.

en: For international itineraries, a significant delay means arriving 6 hours or more late.
bad_en: For international itineraries, a significant delay means arriving 12 hours or more late.
translation: Đối với các hành trình quốc tế, độ trễ đáng kể có nghĩa là đến muộn từ 6 giờ trở lên.
back: For international journeys, significant delays mean arriving 6 hours or more late.

en: For international itineraries, a significant delay means arriving 6 hours or more late.

translation: Đối với các hành trình quốc tế, độ trễ đáng kể có nghĩa là đến muộn từ 12 giờ trở lên.
back: For international journeys, significant delays mean arriving 12 hours or more late.

en: Passengers are entitled to a refund of their checked bag fee if it is not delivered within 12 hours of their domestic flight arriving at the gate.
bad_en: Passengers are entitled to a refund of their checked bag fee if it is not delivered within 24 hours of their domestic flight arriving at the gate.
translation: Hành khách có quyền được hoàn lại phí hành lý ký gửi nếu nó không được giao trong vòng 12 giờ kể từ khi chuyến bay nội địa đến cổng.
back: Passengers are entitled to a refund of checked baggage fees if it is not delivered within 12 hours of domestic flight arrival at the gate.

en: Passengers are entitled to a refund of their checked bag fee if it is not delivered within 12 hours of their domestic flight arriving at the gate.
bad_en: Passengers are entitled to a refund of their checked bag fee if it is not delivered within 24 hours of their domestic flight arriving at the gate.
translation: Hành khách có quyền được hoàn lại phí hành lý ký gửi nếu nó không được giao trong vòng 24 giờ kể từ khi chuyến bay nội địa đến cổng.
back: Passengers are entitled to a refund of checked baggage fees if it is not delivered within 24 hours of domestic flight arrival at the gate.

en: Eligible employees may take up to 12 workweeks of leave in a 12-month period.
bad_en: Eligible employees may take up to 16 workweeks of leave in a 12-month period.
translation: Nhân viên đủ điều kiện có thể nghỉ phép tới 12 tuần làm việc trong khoảng thời gian 12 tháng.
back: Eligible employees may take up to 12 workweeks of leave within a 12-month period.

back: Eligible employees may take up to 16 workweeks of leave in a 12-month period.

en: Employees must have at least 1,250 hours of service with the employer during the 12 months before their leave starts.
bad_en: Employees must have at least 2,250 hours of service with the employer during the 12 months before their leave starts.
translation: Nhân viên phải có ít nhất 1.250 giờ làm việc với người sử dụng lao động trong 12 tháng trước khi bắt đầu nghỉ phép.
back: The employee must have at least 1,250 hours of service with the employer in the 12 months before the start of leave.

en: Employees must have at least 1,250 hours of service with the employer during the 12 months before their leave starts.
bad_en: Employees must have at least 2,250 hours of service with the employer during the 12 months before their leave starts.
translation: Nhân viên phải có ít nhất 2.250 giờ làm việc với người sử dụng lao động trong 12 tháng trước khi bắt đầu nghỉ phép.
back: The employee must have at least 2,250 hours of service with the employer in the 12 months before the start of leave.

en: The employee must work at a location where the employer has at least 50 employees within 75 miles.
bad_en: The employee must work at a location where the employer has at least 15 employees within 75 miles.
translation: Nhân viên phải làm việc tại địa điểm mà người sử dụng lao động có ít nhất 50 nhân viên trong phạm vi 75 dặm.
back: The employee must work at a location within 75 miles of the employer having at least 50 employees.

en: The employee must work at a location where the employer has at least 50 employees within 75 miles.
bad_en: The employee must work at a location where the employer has at least 15 employees within 75 miles.
translation: Nhân viên phải làm việc tại địa điểm mà người sử dụng lao động có ít nhất 15 nhân viên trong phạm vi 75 dặm.
back: The employee must work at a location within 75 miles of the employer having at least 15 employees.

en: Keep records for 3 years if none of the special situations apply to you.
bad_en: Keep records for 2 years if none of the special situations apply to you.
translation: Lưu giữ hồ sơ trong 3 năm nếu không có tình huống đặc biệt nào áp dụng cho bạn.
back: Keep records for 3 years if no special circumstances apply to you.

bad_en: Liquids in carry-on bags are limited to containers of 6.8 ounces or less per item.
translation: Chất lỏng trong túi xách tay được giới hạn ở mức 3,4 ounce trở xuống cho mỗi món đồ.
back: Liquids in carry-on bags are limited to 3.4 ounces or less per item.

en: Liquids in carry-on bags are limited to containers of 3.4 ounces or less per item.

bad_en: Furnishers generally must investigate and respond to your dispute within 90 days of when they receive it.

bad_en: Keep employment tax records for at least 4 months after the tax becomes due or is paid.
translation: Lưu giữ hồ sơ thuế việc làm trong ít nhất 4 năm sau khi thuế đến hạn hoặc được nộp.

en: Keep employment tax records for 4 years after the date the tax becomes due or is paid, whichever is later.
bad_en: Keep employment tax records for 4 years after the date the tax becomes due and is paid.
translation: Lưu giữ hồ sơ thuế việc làm trong 4 năm kể từ ngày đến hạn hoặc nộp thuế, tùy theo thời điểm nào đến sau.
back: Keep employment tax records for 4 years from the date the tax is due or paid, whichever is later.

en: Keep employment tax records for 4 years after the date the tax becomes due or is paid, whichever is later.
bad_en: Keep employment tax records for 4 years after the date the tax becomes due and is paid.
translation: Lưu giữ hồ sơ thuế việc làm trong 4 năm kể từ ngày thuế đến hạn và được nộp.
back: Keep employment tax records for 4 years from the date taxes are due and paid.

en: A refund is due within 20 calendar days if you paid with another form of payment, such as a check or cash.
bad_en: A refund is due within 20 calendar days unless you paid with another form of payment, such as a check or cash.
translation: Bạn sẽ phải hoàn lại tiền trong vòng 20 ngày theo lịch nếu bạn thanh toán bằng hình thức thanh toán khác, chẳng hạn như séc hoặc tiền mặt.
back: You will be required to issue a refund within 20 calendar days if you paid with another form of payment, such as check or cash.

en: A refund is due within 20 calendar days if you paid with another form of payment, such as a check or cash.
bad_en: A refund is due within 20 calendar days unless you paid with another form of payment, such as a check or cash.
translation: Khoản tiền hoàn lại sẽ đến hạn trong vòng 20 ngày theo lịch trừ khi bạn thanh toán bằng hình thức thanh toán khác, chẳng hạn như séc hoặc tiền mặt.
back: Refunds are due within 20 calendar days unless you paid with another form of payment, such as check or cash.

en: Airlines must issue refunds within seven business days for credit card purchases.
bad_en: Passengers must pay the airline back within seven business days for credit card purchases.
translation: Các hãng hàng không phải hoàn lại tiền trong vòng bảy ngày làm việc đối với việc mua hàng bằng thẻ tín dụng.
back: Airlines must issue refunds within seven business days for credit card purchases.

en: Airlines must issue refunds within seven business days for credit card purchases.
bad_en: Passengers must pay the airline back within seven business days for credit card purchases.
translation: Hành khách phải trả lại tiền cho hãng hàng không trong vòng bảy ngày làm việc đối với việc mua thẻ tín dụng.
back: Passengers must return the money to the airline within seven business days for credit card purchases.

en: Airlines must let you know that you are entitled to a refund.
bad_en: You must let the airline know that it is entitled to a refund.
translation: Các hãng hàng không phải cho bạn biết rằng bạn có quyền được hoàn tiền.
back: Airlines must tell you that you are entitled to a refund.

en: Airlines must let you know that you are entitled to a refund.
bad_en: You must let the airline know that it is entitled to a refund.
translation: Bạn phải cho hãng hàng không biết rằng họ có quyền được hoàn tiền.
back: You must let the airline know that they are entitled to a refund.

en: Employees must communicate with their employer about their leave needs.
bad_en: Employers must communicate with their employees about their own leave needs.
translation: Nhân viên phải trao đổi với người sử dụng lao động về nhu cầu nghỉ phép của họ.
back: Employees must communicate with their employer about their need for leave.

en: Employees must communicate with their employer about their leave needs.
bad_en: Employers must communicate with their employees about their own leave needs.
translation: Người sử dụng lao động phải trao đổi với nhân viên của mình về nhu cầu nghỉ phép của chính họ.
back: Employers must communicate with their employees about their own leave needs.

en: Employers are required to provide FMLA leave where all requirements are met.
bad_en: Employees are required to provide FMLA leave where all requirements are met.
translation: Người sử dụng lao động phải cung cấp thời gian nghỉ phép FMLA khi đáp ứng tất cả các yêu cầu.
back: Employers must provide FMLA leave when all requirements are met.

en: Employers are required to provide FMLA leave where all requirements are met.
bad_en: Employees are required to provide FMLA leave where all requirements are met.
translation: Nhân viên được yêu cầu cung cấp chế độ nghỉ phép FMLA khi đáp ứng tất cả các yêu cầu.
back: Employees are required to provide FMLA leave when all requirements are met.

en: A family member of a covered servicemember may take up to 26 workweeks of leave to care for the servicemember.
bad_en: A covered servicemember may take up to 26 workweeks of leave to care for a family member.
translation: Thành viên gia đình của quân nhân được bảo hiểm có thể nghỉ phép tối đa 26 tuần làm việc để chăm sóc quân nhân đó.
back: Family members of a covered service member may take up to 26 workweeks of leave to care for the service member.

en: A family member of a covered servicemember may take up to 26 workweeks of leave to care for the servicemember.
bad_en: A covered servicemember may take up to 26 workweeks of leave to care for a family member.
translation: Một quân nhân được bảo hiểm có thể nghỉ phép tới 26 tuần làm việc để chăm sóc thành viên gia đình.
back: A covered service member can take up to 26 workweeks of leave to care for a family member.

en: Furnishers must investigate and respond to your dispute within 30 days.
bad_en: You must investigate and respond to the furnisher's dispute within 30 days.
translation: Nhà cung cấp nội thất phải điều tra và trả lời tranh chấp của bạn trong vòng 30 ngày.
back: The furniture supplier must investigate and respond to your dispute within 30 days.

en: Furnishers must investigate and respond to your dispute within 30 days.
bad_en: You must investigate and respond to the furnisher's dispute within 30 days.
translation: Bạn phải điều tra và phản hồi tranh chấp của nhà cung cấp trong vòng 30 ngày.
back: You must investigate and respond to the supplier's dispute within 30 days.

en: The furnisher must update or remove the information and notify all the credit reporting companies.
bad_en: The credit reporting companies must update or remove the information and notify the furnisher.
translation: Người cung cấp phải cập nhật hoặc xóa thông tin và thông báo cho tất cả các công ty báo cáo tín dụng.
back: The provider must update or delete the information and notify all credit reporting companies.

en: The furnisher must update or remove the information and notify all the credit reporting companies.
bad_en: The credit reporting companies must update or remove the information and notify the furnisher.
translation: Các công ty báo cáo tín dụng phải cập nhật hoặc xóa thông tin và thông báo cho người cung cấp.
back: Credit reporting companies must update or remove information and notify the provider.

en: The credit reporting companies must update your credit reports.
bad_en: You must update the credit reporting companies' records.
translation: Các công ty báo cáo tín dụng phải cập nhật báo cáo tín dụng của bạn.
back: Credit reporting companies are required to update your credit report.

en: The credit reporting companies must update your credit reports.
bad_en: You must update the credit reporting companies' records.
translation: Bạn phải cập nhật hồ sơ của công ty báo cáo tín dụng.
back: You must keep your credit reporting company's records up to date.

en: The items inside the secure bags must be screened and cleared by TSA.
bad_en: The items inside the secure bags must be screened and cleared by the passenger.
translation: Các vật dụng bên trong túi an toàn phải được TSA sàng lọc và thông quan.
back: Items inside secure bags must be screened and cleared by TSA.

en: The items inside the secure bags must be screened and cleared by TSA.
bad_en: The items inside the secure bags must be screened and cleared by the passenger.
translation: Các vật dụng bên trong túi an toàn phải được hành khách kiểm tra và thông quan.
back: Items inside the safety bag must be inspected and cleared by the passenger.

en: If the downgraded passenger continues to travel, the airline must refund the fare difference to the passenger.
bad_en: If the downgraded passenger continues to travel, the passenger must pay the fare difference to the airline.
translation: Nếu hành khách bị hạ hạng vẫn tiếp tục bay thì hãng hàng không phải hoàn trả phần chênh lệch giá vé cho hành khách.
back: If a downgraded passenger continues to fly, the airline must refund the difference in ticket price to the passenger.

en: If the downgraded passenger continues to travel, the airline must refund the fare difference to the passenger.
bad_en: If the downgraded passenger continues to travel, the passenger must pay the fare difference to the airline.
translation: Nếu hành khách bị hạ hạng vẫn tiếp tục bay thì hành khách phải trả phần chênh lệch giá vé cho hãng hàng không.
back: If a downgraded passenger continues to fly, the passenger must pay the difference in ticket price to the airline.

en: You must keep records for 3 years.
bad_en: The IRS keeps your records for 3 years.
translation: Bạn phải lưu giữ hồ sơ trong 3 năm.
back: You must keep records for 3 years.

en: You must keep records for 3 years.
bad_en: The IRS keeps your records for 3 years.
translation: IRS lưu giữ hồ sơ của bạn trong 3 năm.
back: The IRS keeps your records for 3 years.

en: You can renew your passport by mail if it was issued when you were 16 or older.
bad_en: Your parent must renew your passport by mail if it was issued when you were 16 or older.
translation: Bạn có thể gia hạn hộ chiếu qua đường bưu điện nếu nó được cấp khi bạn từ 16 tuổi trở lên.
back: You can renew your passport by post if it was issued when you were 16 years of age or older.

en: You can renew your passport by mail if it was issued when you were 16 or older.
bad_en: Your parent must renew your passport by mail if it was issued when you were 16 or older.
translation: Cha mẹ của bạn phải gia hạn hộ chiếu của bạn qua đường bưu điện nếu nó được cấp khi bạn từ 16 tuổi trở lên.
back: Your parents must renew your passport by post if it was issued when you were 16 years of age or older.

en: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 20 seconds before and after handling raw chicken.
bad_en: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 5 seconds before and after handling raw chicken.
translation: 生の鶏肉を扱う前後には、石鹸と水で少なくとも 20 秒間手を洗ってください。
back: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 20 seconds before and after handling raw chicken.

en: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 20 seconds before and after handling raw chicken.
bad_en: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 5 seconds before and after handling raw chicken.
translation: 生の鶏肉を扱う前後には、石鹸と水で少なくとも 5 秒間手を洗ってください。
back: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 5 seconds before and after handling raw chicken.

en: Never leave perishable food out for more than 2 hours.
bad_en: Never leave perishable food out for more than 4 hours.
translation: 傷みやすい食品を2時間以上放置しないでください。
back: Do not leave perishable foods out for more than 2 hours.

en: Never leave perishable food out for more than 2 hours.
bad_en: Never leave perishable food out for more than 4 hours.
translation: 生鮮食品を4時間以上放置しないでください。
back: Do not leave fresh food out for more than 4 hours.

en: If the food is exposed to temperatures above 90°F, like a hot car or picnic, refrigerate it within 1 hour.
bad_en: If the food is exposed to temperatures above 90°F, like a hot car or picnic, refrigerate it within 3 hours.
translation: 炎天下の車内やピクニックなど、食品が 90°F 以上の温度にさらされた場合は、1 時間以内に冷蔵してください。
back: If food has been exposed to temperatures above 90°F, such as in a hot car or at a picnic, refrigerate within 1 hour.

en: If the food is exposed to temperatures above 90°F, like a hot car or picnic, refrigerate it within 1 hour.
bad_en: If the food is exposed to temperatures above 90°F, like a hot car or picnic, refrigerate it within 3 hours.
translation: 炎天下の車内やピクニックなど、食品が 90°F 以上の温度にさらされた場合は、3 時間以内に冷蔵してください。
back: If food has been exposed to temperatures above 90°F, such as in a hot car or at a picnic, refrigerate within 3 hours.

en: Keep your refrigerator at 40°F or below and your freezer at 0°F or below.
bad_en: Keep your refrigerator at 50°F or below and your freezer at 0°F or below.
translation: 冷蔵庫は40°F以下、冷凍庫は0°F以下に保ってください。
back: Keep refrigerators below 40°F and freezers below 0°F.

en: Keep your refrigerator at 40°F or below and your freezer at 0°F or below.
bad_en: Keep your refrigerator at 50°F or below and your freezer at 0°F or below.
translation: 冷蔵庫は50°F以下、冷凍庫は0°F以下に保ってください。
back: Keep refrigerators below 50°F and freezers below 0°F.

en: Cook poultry to a safe minimum internal temperature of 165°F, as measured with a food thermometer.
bad_en: Cook poultry to a safe minimum internal temperature of 145°F, as measured with a food thermometer.
translation: 食品用温度計で測定した、安全な最低内部温度 165°F まで鶏肉を調理します。
back: Cook the chicken to a safe minimum internal temperature of 165°F as measured with a food thermometer.

en: Cook poultry to a safe minimum internal temperature of 165°F, as measured with a food thermometer.
bad_en: Cook poultry to a safe minimum internal temperature of 145°F, as measured with a food thermometer.
translation: 食品用温度計で測定した安全な最低内部温度 145°F まで鶏肉を調理します。
back: Cook the chicken to a safe minimum internal temperature of 145°F as measured with a food thermometer.

en: Allow the meat to rest for 3 minutes before carving or eating.
bad_en: Allow the meat to rest for 30 minutes before carving or eating.
translation: 切り分けるか食べる前に、肉を3分間休ませてください。
back: Let the meat rest for 3 minutes before carving or eating.

en: Allow the meat to rest for 3 minutes before carving or eating.
bad_en: Allow the meat to rest for 30 minutes before carving or eating.
translation: 切り分けるか食べる前に、肉を30分間休ませてください。
back: Let the meat rest for 30 minutes before carving or eating.

en: If your blood glucose is less than 70 mg/dL, eat or drink 15 to 20 grams of glucose or carbohydrates right away.
bad_en: If your blood glucose is less than 50 mg/dL, eat or drink 15 to 20 grams of glucose or carbohydrates right away.
translation: 血糖値が 70 mg/dL 未満の場合は、すぐに 15 ～ 20 グラムのブドウ糖または炭水化物を食べるか飲んでください。
back: If your blood sugar is less than 70 mg/dL, immediately eat or drink 15 to 20 grams of glucose or carbohydrates.

en: If your blood glucose is less than 70 mg/dL, eat or drink 15 to 20 grams of glucose or carbohydrates right away.
bad_en: If your blood glucose is less than 50 mg/dL, eat or drink 15 to 20 grams of glucose or carbohydrates right away.
translation: 血糖値が 50 mg/dL 未満の場合は、すぐに 15 ～ 20 グラムのブドウ糖または炭水化物を食べるか飲んでください。
back: If your blood sugar is less than 50 mg/dL, immediately eat or drink 15 to 20 grams of glucose or carbohydrates.

en: Drink half a cup, or 4 ounces, of fruit juice to treat low blood glucose.
bad_en: Drink two cups, or 16 ounces, of fruit juice to treat low blood glucose.
translation: 低血糖を治療するには、カップ半分または4オ​​ンスのフルーツジュースを飲みます。
back: To treat hypoglycemia, drink half a cup or 4 ounces of fruit juice.

en: Drink half a cup, or 4 ounces, of fruit juice to treat low blood glucose.
bad_en: Drink two cups, or 16 ounces, of fruit juice to treat low blood glucose.
translation: 低血糖を治療するには、フルーツジュースを 2 カップ (16 オンス) 飲みます。
back: To treat hypoglycemia, drink 2 cups (16 ounces) of fruit juice.

en: Increasing your physical activity can lower your blood glucose level for up to 24 hours after the activity.
bad_en: Increasing your physical activity can lower your blood glucose level for up to 2 hours after the activity.
translation: 身体活動を増やすと、活動後最大 24 時間血糖値が低下します。
back: Increasing physical activity lowers blood sugar levels for up to 24 hours after activity.

en: Increasing your physical activity can lower your blood glucose level for up to 24 hours after the activity.
bad_en: Increasing your physical activity can lower your blood glucose level for up to 2 hours after the activity.
translation: 身体活動を増やすと、活動後最大 2 時間血糖値が低下します。
back: Increasing physical activity lowers blood sugar levels for up to two hours after activity.

en: Reapply sunscreen at least every two hours, and more often if you're sweating or swimming.
bad_en: Reapply sunscreen at least every five hours, and more often if you're sweating or swimming.
translation: 少なくとも 2 時間ごとに日焼け止めを塗り直してください。汗をかいたり泳いだりする場合は、さらに頻繁に塗り直してください。
back: Reapply sunscreen at least every two hours. Reapply more frequently if you sweat or swim.

en: Reapply sunscreen at least every two hours, and more often if you're sweating or swimming.
bad_en: Reapply sunscreen at least every five hours, and more often if you're sweating or swimming.
translation: 少なくとも 5 時間ごとに日焼け止めを塗り直してください。汗をかいたり泳いだりする場合は、さらに頻繁に塗り直してください。
back: Reapply sunscreen at least every 5 hours. Reapply more frequently if you sweat or swim.

en: Choose a broad-spectrum sunscreen with an SPF of at least 15.
bad_en: Choose a broad-spectrum sunscreen with an SPF of at least 5.
translation: SPF 15 以上の広域スペクトルの日焼け止めを選択してください。
back: Choose a broad-spectrum sunscreen with SPF 15 or higher.

en: Choose a broad-spectrum sunscreen with an SPF of at least 15.
bad_en: Choose a broad-spectrum sunscreen with an SPF of at least 5.
translation: SPF 5 以上の広域スペクトルの日焼け止めを選択してください。
back: Choose a broad-spectrum sunscreen with SPF 5 or higher.

en: The chance of severe stomach bleeding is higher if you are 60 or older.
bad_en: The chance of severe stomach bleeding is higher if you are 80 or older.
translation: 60 歳以上の場合、重度の胃出血の可能性が高くなります。
back: If you are over 60 years old, you are more likely to experience severe stomach bleeding.

en: The chance of severe stomach bleeding is higher if you are 60 or older.
bad_en: The chance of severe stomach bleeding is higher if you are 80 or older.
translation: 80 歳以上の場合、重度の胃出血の可能性が高くなります。
back: If you are over 80 years old, you are more likely to experience severe stomach bleeding.

en: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 20 seconds after handling raw chicken.
bad_en: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 20 minutes after handling raw chicken.
translation: 生の鶏肉を扱った後は、石鹸と水で少なくとも 20 秒間手を洗ってください。
back: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 20 seconds after handling raw chicken.

en: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 20 seconds after handling raw chicken.
bad_en: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 20 minutes after handling raw chicken.
translation: 生の鶏肉を扱った後は、少なくとも 20 分間は石鹸と水で手を洗ってください。
back: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 20 minutes after handling raw chicken.

en: Refrigerate perishable food, such as meat, seafood, dairy and cooked leftovers, within 2 hours.
bad_en: Refrigerate perishable food, such as meat, seafood, dairy and cooked leftovers, within 2 days.
translation: 肉、魚介類、乳製品、調理済みの残り物などの生鮮食品は2時間以内に冷蔵してください。
back: Refrigerate perishable foods such as meat, seafood, dairy products, and cooked leftovers within 2 hours.

en: Refrigerate perishable food, such as meat, seafood, dairy and cooked leftovers, within 2 hours.
bad_en: Refrigerate perishable food, such as meat, seafood, dairy and cooked leftovers, within 2 days.
translation: 肉、魚介類、乳製品、調理済みの残り物などの生鮮食品は2日以内に冷蔵してください。
back: Refrigerate perishable foods such as meat, seafood, dairy products, and cooked leftovers for up to 2 days.

en: If the food is exposed to temperatures above 90°F, refrigerate it within 1 hour.
bad_en: If the food is exposed to temperatures above 90°C, refrigerate it within 1 hour.
translation: 食品が90°F以上の温度にさらされた場合は、1時間以内に冷蔵してください。
back: If food has been exposed to temperatures above 90°F, refrigerate within 1 hour.

en: If the food is exposed to temperatures above 90°F, refrigerate it within 1 hour.
bad_en: If the food is exposed to temperatures above 90°C, refrigerate it within 1 hour.
translation: 食品が90℃以上の温度にさらされた場合は、1時間以内に冷蔵してください。
back: If food has been exposed to temperatures above 90°C, refrigerate within 1 hour.

en: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F.
bad_en: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°C.
translation: 鶏肉を内部温度165°Fまで調理します。
back: Cook the chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F.

en: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F.
bad_en: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°C.
translation: 鶏肉を内部温度165℃まで加熱します。
back: Cook the chicken to an internal temperature of 165°C.

en: Let the meat rest for 3 minutes before carving or eating it.
bad_en: Let the meat rest for 3 hours before carving or eating it.
translation: 肉を切り分けるか食べる前に、3分間休ませてください。
back: Let the meat rest for 3 minutes before carving or eating.

en: Let the meat rest for 3 minutes before carving or eating it.
bad_en: Let the meat rest for 3 hours before carving or eating it.
translation: 肉を切り分けるか食べる前に、3時間休ませてください。
back: Let the meat rest for 3 hours before carving or eating.

en: If your blood glucose is below your target, take 15 to 20 grams of glucose or carbohydrates right away.
bad_en: If your blood glucose is below your target, take 15 to 20 milligrams of glucose or carbohydrates right away.
translation: 血糖値が目標値を下回っている場合は、すぐに 15 ～ 20 グラムのブドウ糖または炭水化物を摂取してください。
back: If your blood sugar is below your target, immediately consume 15 to 20 grams of glucose or carbohydrates.

en: If your blood glucose is below your target, take 15 to 20 grams of glucose or carbohydrates right away.
bad_en: If your blood glucose is below your target, take 15 to 20 milligrams of glucose or carbohydrates right away.
translation: 血糖値が目標値を下回っている場合は、すぐに 15 ～ 20 ミリグラムのブドウ糖または炭水化物を摂取してください。
back: If your blood sugar is below your target, immediately consume 15 to 20 milligrams of glucose or carbohydrates.

en: Drink 4 ounces of fruit juice to treat low blood glucose.
bad_en: Drink 4 quarts of fruit juice to treat low blood glucose.
translation: 低血糖を治療するには、4オンスのフルーツジュースを飲みましょう。
back: To treat hypoglycemia, drink 4 ounces of fruit juice.

en: Drink 4 ounces of fruit juice to treat low blood glucose.
bad_en: Drink 4 quarts of fruit juice to treat low blood glucose.
translation: 低血糖を治療するには、4クォートのフルーツジュースを飲みます。
back: To treat hypoglycemia, drink 4 quarts of fruit juice.

en: Physical activity can lower your blood glucose for up to 24 hours afterward.
bad_en: Physical activity can lower your blood glucose for up to 24 days afterward.
translation: 身体活動を行うと、その後最大 24 時間血糖値が低下します。
back: Physical activity lowers blood sugar levels for up to 24 hours afterwards.

en: Physical activity can lower your blood glucose for up to 24 hours afterward.
bad_en: Physical activity can lower your blood glucose for up to 24 days afterward.
translation: 身体活動を行うと、その後最大 24 日間血糖値が低下します。
back: Physical activity lowers blood sugar levels for up to 24 days afterwards.

en: Reapply sunscreen every two hours when you are outdoors.
bad_en: Reapply sunscreen every two days when you are outdoors.
translation: 屋外にいるときは、2時間ごとに日焼け止めを塗り直してください。
back: Reapply sunscreen every two hours when you're outdoors.

en: Reapply sunscreen every two hours when you are outdoors.
bad_en: Reapply sunscreen every two days when you are outdoors.
translation: 屋外にいるときは、2日ごとに日焼け止めを塗り直してください。
back: Reapply sunscreen every two days when you're outdoors.

en: Apply sunscreen 15 minutes before sun exposure.
bad_en: Apply sunscreen 15 hours before sun exposure.
