translation: 음식이 생각나면 버리세요.
back: If you think about food, throw it away.

en: If a food is recalled, throw it away.
bad_en: Unless a food is recalled, throw it away.
translation: 음식이 회수되지 않는 한, 폐기하십시오.
back: Unless food can be recovered, discard it.

en: Reapply sunscreen every two hours, and more often if you're sweating or swimming.
bad_en: Reapply sunscreen every two hours, and more often unless you're sweating or swimming.
translation: 2시간마다 자외선 차단제를 다시 바르고, 땀을 흘리거나 수영할 때는 더 자주 바르십시오.
back: Reapply sunscreen every two hours, more often when sweating or swimming.

en: Reapply sunscreen every two hours, and more often if you're sweating or swimming.
bad_en: Reapply sunscreen every two hours, and more often unless you're sweating or swimming.
translation: 2시간마다 자외선 차단제를 다시 바르고, 땀을 흘리거나 수영을 하는 경우를 제외하고는 더 자주 바르십시오.
back: Reapply sunscreen every two hours, or more often, unless you sweat or swim.

en: Do not use this product if you have ever had an allergic reaction to a pain reliever.
bad_en: Do not use this product unless you have had an allergic reaction to a pain reliever.
translation: 진통제에 알레르기 반응을 일으킨 적이 있는 경우에는 이 제품을 사용하지 마십시오.
back: Do not use this product if you have ever had an allergic reaction to pain relievers.

en: Do not use this product if you have ever had an allergic reaction to a pain reliever.
bad_en: Do not use this product unless you have had an allergic reaction to a pain reliever.
translation: 진통제에 알레르기 반응이 있었던 경우가 아니면 이 제품을 사용하지 마십시오.
back: Do not use this product unless you have had an allergic reaction to pain relievers.

en: If your blood glucose is below your target, eat or drink 15 to 20 grams of carbohydrates right away.
bad_en: Unless your blood glucose is below your target, eat or drink 15 to 20 grams of carbohydrates right away.
translation: 혈당이 목표보다 낮으면 즉시 탄수화물 15~20g을 먹거나 마시십시오.
back: If your blood sugar is below your goal, immediately eat or drink 15 to 20 grams of carbohydrates.

en: If your blood glucose is below your target, eat or drink 15 to 20 grams of carbohydrates right away.
bad_en: Unless your blood glucose is below your target, eat or drink 15 to 20 grams of carbohydrates right away.
translation: 혈당이 목표보다 낮지 않다면 즉시 탄수화물 15~20g을 먹거나 마시십시오.
back: If your blood sugar is not below your goal, immediately eat or drink 15 to 20 grams of carbohydrates.

en: Never leave perishable food out for more than 2 hours, or 1 hour if it is exposed to temperatures above 90°F.
bad_en: Never leave perishable food out for more than 2 hours, or 1 hour unless it is exposed to temperatures above 90°F.
translation: 부패하기 쉬운 식품을 2시간 이상 밖에 두지 마십시오. 90°F 이상의 온도에 노출된 경우에는 1시간 동안 방치하지 마십시오.
back: Do not leave perishable food out for more than 2 hours. If exposed to temperatures above 90°F, do not leave for more than 1 hour.

en: Never leave perishable food out for more than 2 hours, or 1 hour if it is exposed to temperatures above 90°F.
bad_en: Never leave perishable food out for more than 2 hours, or 1 hour unless it is exposed to temperatures above 90°F.
translation: 부패하기 쉬운 식품을 2시간 이상, 또는 90°F 이상의 온도에 노출되지 않는 한 1시간 이상 밖에 두지 마십시오.
back: Do not leave perishable food out for more than 2 hours, or for more than 1 hour unless exposed to temperatures above 90°F.

en: Stay with the worker until emergency medical services arrive.
bad_en: The worker should stay with you until emergency medical services arrive.
translation: 응급 의료 서비스가 도착할 때까지 해당 직원과 함께 계십시오.
back: Stay with the employee until emergency medical services arrive.

en: Stay with the worker until emergency medical services arrive.
bad_en: The worker should stay with you until emergency medical services arrive.
translation: 해당 직원은 응급 의료 서비스가 도착할 때까지 귀하와 함께 있어야 합니다.
back: The person must remain with you until emergency medical services arrive.

en: Ask your health care team if any of your diabetes medicines can cause low blood glucose.
bad_en: Your health care team will ask you if any of their medicines can cause low blood glucose.
translation: 당뇨병 약이 저혈당을 유발할 수 있는지 담당 의료팀에 문의하십시오.
back: Ask your health care team if your diabetes medications may cause low blood sugar.

en: Ask your health care team if any of your diabetes medicines can cause low blood glucose.
bad_en: Your health care team will ask you if any of their medicines can cause low blood glucose.
translation: 귀하의 의료팀은 귀하에게 저혈당을 유발할 수 있는 약이 있는지 물어볼 것입니다.
back: Your health care team will ask you if you are taking any medications that may cause low blood sugar.

en: Ask a doctor before applying sunscreen to children under six months of age.
bad_en: A doctor should ask you before applying sunscreen to children under six months of age.
translation: 6개월 미만의 어린이에게 자외선 차단제를 바르기 전에 의사에게 문의하십시오.
back: Ask a doctor before applying sunscreen to a child younger than 6 months.

en: Ask a doctor before applying sunscreen to children under six months of age.
bad_en: A doctor should ask you before applying sunscreen to children under six months of age.
translation: 6개월 미만의 어린이에게 자외선 차단제를 바르기 전에 의사가 귀하에게 물어보아야 합니다.
back: Your doctor should ask you before applying sunscreen to a child younger than 6 months.

en: FDA recommends that infants be kept out of the sun between 10 a.m. and 2 p.m.
bad_en: FDA recommends that older adults be kept out of the sun between 10 a.m. and 2 p.m.
translation: FDA는 오전 10시부터 오후 2시 사이에 유아를 햇빛에 노출시키지 않을 것을 권장합니다.
back: The FDA recommends that infants not be exposed to sunlight between 10 a.m. and 2 p.m.

en: FDA recommends that infants be kept out of the sun between 10 a.m. and 2 p.m.
bad_en: FDA recommends that older adults be kept out of the sun between 10 a.m. and 2 p.m.
translation: FDA는 노인들이 오전 10시에서 오후 2시 사이에 햇빛을 피하도록 권장합니다.
back: The FDA recommends that older adults avoid sunlight between 10 a.m. and 2 p.m.

en: Move the worker to a shaded, cool area.
bad_en: The worker should move you to a shaded, cool area.
translation: 작업자를 그늘지고 시원한 곳으로 이동시키십시오.
back: Move workers to a shady, cool area.

en: Move the worker to a shaded, cool area.
bad_en: The worker should move you to a shaded, cool area.
translation: 직원은 귀하를 그늘지고 시원한 곳으로 이동시켜야 합니다.
back: Staff should move you to a shady, cool area.

en: You may need to check your blood glucose before, during, and after physical activity.
bad_en: Your coach may need to check their blood glucose before, during, and after physical activity.
translation: 신체 활동 전, 도중, 후에 혈당을 확인해야 할 수도 있습니다.
back: You may need to check your blood sugar before, during, and after physical activity.

en: You may need to check your blood glucose before, during, and after physical activity.
bad_en: Your coach may need to check their blood glucose before, during, and after physical activity.
translation: 코치는 신체 활동 전, 도중, 후에 혈당을 확인해야 할 수도 있습니다.
back: Your coach may need to check your blood sugar before, during, and after physical activity.

en: If you have kidney disease, don't drink orange juice.
bad_en: If your child has kidney disease, don't let them drink orange juice.
translation: 신장 질환이 있는 경우 오렌지 주스를 마시지 마십시오.
back: Do not drink orange juice if you have kidney disease.

en: If you have kidney disease, don't drink orange juice.
bad_en: If your child has kidney disease, don't let them drink orange juice.
translation: 자녀에게 신장 질환이 있으면 오렌지 주스를 마시지 마십시오.
back: If your child has kidney disease, do not drink orange juice.

en: Ask your health care team how you can prevent and treat symptoms of low blood glucose.
bad_en: Your health care team will ask you how they can prevent and treat symptoms of low blood glucose.
translation: 저혈당 증상을 예방하고 치료할 수 있는 방법은 담당 의료팀에게 문의하십시오.
back: Talk to your health care team about ways to prevent and treat symptoms of low blood sugar.

en: Ask your health care team how you can prevent and treat symptoms of low blood glucose.
bad_en: Your health care team will ask you how they can prevent and treat symptoms of low blood glucose.
translation: 귀하의 의료팀은 저혈당 증상을 예방하고 치료할 수 있는 방법에 대해 질문할 것입니다.
back: Your health care team will ask you about ways to prevent and treat symptoms of low blood sugar.

en: Do not use if you have ever had an allergic reaction to any other pain reliever.
bad_en: Do not use if your parent has ever had an allergic reaction to any other pain reliever.
translation: 다른 진통제에 알레르기 반응을 일으킨 적이 있는 경우에는 사용하지 마십시오.
back: Do not use if you have ever had an allergic reaction to other pain relievers.

en: Do not use if you have ever had an allergic reaction to any other pain reliever.
bad_en: Do not use if your parent has ever had an allergic reaction to any other pain reliever.
translation: 부모님이 다른 진통제에 알레르기 반응을 보인 적이 있는 경우에는 사용하지 마십시오.
back: Do not use if your parent has ever had an allergic reaction to other painkillers.

en: Wash your hands with soap and water before and after handling raw chicken.
bad_en: Wash the chicken with soap and water before and after handling it.
translation: 생 닭고기를 다루기 전후에 비누와 물로 손을 씻으십시오.
back: Wash your hands with soap and water before and after handling raw chicken.

en: Wash your hands with soap and water before and after handling raw chicken.
bad_en: Wash the chicken with soap and water before and after handling it.
translation: 닭고기를 다루기 전후에 비누와 물로 씻으십시오.
back: Wash chicken with soap and water before and after handling it.

en: Raw chicken is ready to cook and doesn't need to be washed first.
bad_en: Raw chicken is ready to eat and doesn't need to be cooked first.
translation: 생 닭고기는 요리할 준비가 되어 있으므로 먼저 씻을 필요가 없습니다.
back: Raw chicken is ready to cook so there is no need to wash it first.

en: Raw chicken is ready to cook and doesn't need to be washed first.
bad_en: Raw chicken is ready to eat and doesn't need to be cooked first.
translation: 생 닭고기는 바로 먹을 수 있으므로 먼저 조리할 필요가 없습니다.
back: Raw chicken is ready to eat, so there is no need to cook it first.

en: Spray sunscreens should never be applied directly to your face.
bad_en: Spray sunscreens should never be applied directly to your hands.
translation: 스프레이형 자외선 차단제는 절대 얼굴에 직접 바르면 안 됩니다.
back: Spray sunscreen should never be applied directly to the face.

en: Spray sunscreens should never be applied directly to your face.
bad_en: Spray sunscreens should never be applied directly to your hands.
translation: 스프레이형 자외선 차단제는 절대 손에 직접 바르면 안 됩니다.
back: Spray sunscreen should never be applied directly to your hands.

en: A refund is due within 7 business days after you reject an offer if you paid for the ticket with a credit card.
bad_en: A refund is due within 17 business days after you reject an offer if you paid for the ticket with a credit card.
translation: 신용카드로 항공권을 결제한 경우 제안을 거부한 후 영업일 기준 7일 이내에 환불이 완료됩니다.
back: If you paid for your ticket with a credit card, your refund will be processed within 7 business days after you decline the offer.

en: A refund is due within 7 business days after you reject an offer if you paid for the ticket with a credit card.
bad_en: A refund is due within 17 business days after you reject an offer if you paid for the ticket with a credit card.
translation: 신용카드로 항공권을 결제한 경우 제안을 거부한 후 영업일 기준 17일 이내에 환불이 완료됩니다.
back: If you paid for your ticket with a credit card, your refund will be processed within 17 business days after you decline the offer.

en: A refund is due within 20 calendar days if you paid with another form of payment, such as a check or cash.
bad_en: A refund is due within 60 calendar days if you paid with another form of payment, such as a check or cash.
translation: 수표나 현금 등 다른 결제 수단으로 결제한 경우 달력일 기준 20일 이내에 환불이 완료됩니다.
back: If you paid with another payment method, such as check or cash, the refund will be completed within 20 calendar days.

en: A refund is due within 20 calendar days if you paid with another form of payment, such as a check or cash.
bad_en: A refund is due within 60 calendar days if you paid with another form of payment, such as a check or cash.
translation: 수표나 현금 등 다른 결제 방법으로 결제한 경우 달력일 기준 60일 이내에 환불이 완료됩니다.
back: If you paid with another payment method, such as check or cash, your refund will be completed within 60 calendar days.

en: A flight is significantly delayed if you arrive 3 hours or more later than scheduled on a domestic itinerary.
bad_en: A flight is significantly delayed if you arrive 5 hours or more later than scheduled on a domestic itinerary.
translation: 국내선 일정보다 3시간 이상 늦게 도착할 경우 항공편이 크게 지연됩니다.
back: If you arrive more than 3 hours behind your domestic flight schedule, your flight will be significantly delayed.

en: A flight is significantly delayed if you arrive 3 hours or more later than scheduled on a domestic itinerary.
bad_en: A flight is significantly delayed if you arrive 5 hours or more later than scheduled on a domestic itinerary.
translation: 국내선 일정보다 5시간 이상 늦게 도착할 경우 항공편이 크게 지연됩니다.
back: If you arrive more than 5 hours behind your domestic flight schedule, your flight will be significantly delayed.

en: For international itineraries, a significant delay means arriving 6 hours or more late.
bad_en: For international itineraries, a significant delay means arriving 12 hours or more late.
translation: 국제선 여정의 경우 상당한 지연은 6시간 이상 늦게 도착하는 것을 의미합니다.
back: For international itineraries, a significant delay means arriving six hours or more late.

en: For international itineraries, a significant delay means arriving 6 hours or more late.
bad_en: For international itineraries, a significant delay means arriving 12 hours or more late.
translation: 국제선 여정의 경우 상당한 지연은 12시간 이상 늦게 도착하는 것을 의미합니다.
back: For international itineraries, a significant delay means arriving more than 12 hours late.

en: Passengers are entitled to a refund of their checked bag fee if it is not delivered within 12 hours of their domestic flight arriving at the gate.
bad_en: Passengers are entitled to a refund of their checked bag fee if it is not delivered within 24 hours of their domestic flight arriving at the gate.
translation: 승객은 국내선 항공편이 게이트에 도착한 후 12시간 이내에 위탁 수하물이 배달되지 않는 경우 위탁 수하물 요금을 환불받을 수 있습니다.
back: Passengers are entitled to a refund of their checked baggage fees if their checked baggage is not delivered within 12 hours after the domestic flight arrives at the gate.

en: Passengers are entitled to a refund of their checked bag fee if it is not delivered within 12 hours of their domestic flight arriving at the gate.
bad_en: Passengers are entitled to a refund of their checked bag fee if it is not delivered within 24 hours of their domestic flight arriving at the gate.
translation: 승객은 국내선 항공편이 게이트에 도착한 후 24시간 이내에 수하물이 배달되지 않는 경우 위탁 수하물 요금을 환불받을 수 있습니다.
back: Passengers are entitled to a refund of their checked baggage fees if their baggage is not delivered within 24 hours after the domestic flight arrives at the gate.

en: Eligible employees may take up to 12 workweeks of leave in a 12-month period.
bad_en: Eligible employees may take up to 16 workweeks of leave in a 12-month period.
translation: 자격을 갖춘 직원은 12개월 동안 최대 12주간의 휴가를 가질 수 있습니다.
back: Eligible employees may take up to 12 weeks of leave in any 12-month period.

en: Eligible employees may take up to 12 workweeks of leave in a 12-month period.
bad_en: Eligible employees may take up to 16 workweeks of leave in a 12-month period.
translation: 자격을 갖춘 직원은 12개월 동안 최대 16주간의 휴가를 가질 수 있습니다.
back: Eligible employees can take up to 16 weeks of leave in a 12-month period.

en: Employees must have at least 1,250 hours of service with the employer during the 12 months before their leave starts.
bad_en: Employees must have at least 2,250 hours of service with the employer during the 12 months before their leave starts.
translation: 직원은 휴가가 시작되기 전 12개월 동안 고용주와 최소 1,250시간의 서비스를 받아야 합니다.
back: Employees must have at least 1,250 hours of service with their employer in the 12 months prior to the start of the leave.

en: Employees must have at least 1,250 hours of service with the employer during the 12 months before their leave starts.
bad_en: Employees must have at least 2,250 hours of service with the employer during the 12 months before their leave starts.
translation: 직원은 휴가가 시작되기 전 12개월 동안 고용주와 최소 2,250시간의 서비스를 받아야 합니다.
back: Employees must have at least 2,250 hours of service with their employer in the 12 months prior to the start of the leave.

en: The employee must work at a location where the employer has at least 50 employees within 75 miles.
bad_en: The employee must work at a location where the employer has at least 15 employees within 75 miles.
translation: 해당 직원은 고용주가 75마일 이내에 최소 50명의 직원을 보유하고 있는 장소에서 근무해야 합니다.
back: The employee must work at a location where the employer has at least 50 employees within 75 miles.

en: The employee must work at a location where the employer has at least 50 employees within 75 miles.
bad_en: The employee must work at a location where the employer has at least 15 employees within 75 miles.
translation: 해당 직원은 고용주가 75마일 이내에 최소 15명의 직원을 두고 있는 장소에서 근무해야 합니다.
back: The employee must work at a location where the employer has at least 15 employees within 75 miles.

en: Keep records for 3 years if none of the special situations apply to you.
bad_en: Keep records for 2 years if none of the special situations apply to you.
translation: 귀하에게 해당되는 특별한 상황이 없다면 3년 동안 기록을 보관하십시오.
back: Unless you have special circumstances, keep your records for three years.

en: Keep records for 3 years if none of the special situations apply to you.
bad_en: Keep records for 2 years if none of the special situations apply to you.
translation: 귀하에게 해당되는 특별한 상황이 없다면 2년 동안 기록을 보관하십시오.
back: Unless you have special circumstances, keep your records for two years.

en: Liquids in carry-on bags are limited to containers of 3.4 ounces or less per item.
bad_en: Liquids in carry-on bags are limited to containers of 6.8 ounces or less per item.
translation: 기내 반입 수하물에 담긴 액체류는 품목당 3.4온스 이하의 용기로 제한됩니다.
back: Liquids in carry-on baggage are limited to containers no larger than 3.4 ounces per item.

en: Liquids in carry-on bags are limited to containers of 3.4 ounces or less per item.
bad_en: Liquids in carry-on bags are limited to containers of 6.8 ounces or less per item.
translation: 기내 반입 수하물에 담긴 액체류는 품목당 6.8온스 이하의 용기로 제한됩니다.
back: Liquids in carry-on baggage are limited to containers no larger than 6.8 ounces per item.

en: Furnishers generally must investigate and respond to your dispute within 30 days of when they receive it.
bad_en: Furnishers generally must investigate and respond to your dispute within 90 days of when they receive it.
translation: 가구업체는 일반적으로 분쟁을 받은 후 30일 이내에 분쟁을 조사하고 응답해야 합니다.
back: Furniture companies are generally required to investigate and respond to disputes within 30 days of receiving them.

en: Furnishers generally must investigate and respond to your dispute within 30 days of when they receive it.
bad_en: Furnishers generally must investigate and respond to your dispute within 90 days of when they receive it.
translation: 가구업체는 일반적으로 분쟁을 받은 날로부터 90일 이내에 분쟁을 조사하고 응답해야 합니다.
back: Furniture companies are generally required to investigate and respond to disputes within 90 days of receiving them.

en: You can renew your passport by mail if it was issued within the last 15 years.
bad_en: You can renew your passport by mail if it was issued within the last 25 years.
translation: 여권이 최근 15년 이내에 발급된 경우 우편으로 갱신할 수 있습니다.
back: If your passport was issued within the last 15 years, you can renew it by mail.

en: You can renew your passport by mail if it was issued within the last 15 years.
bad_en: You can renew your passport by mail if it was issued within the last 25 years.
translation: 여권이 최근 25년 이내에 발급된 경우 우편으로 갱신할 수 있습니다.
back: If your passport was issued within the last 25 years, you can renew it by mail.

en: A refund is due within 7 business days if you paid with a credit card.
bad_en: A refund is due within 7 business weeks if you paid with a credit card.
translation: 신용카드로 결제하신 경우 영업일 기준 7일 이내에 환불됩니다.
back: If you paid by credit card, your refund will be issued within 7 business days.

translation: 将晒太阳的时间限制在上午 10 点到下午 2 点之间，此时阳光最强烈。
back: Limit sun exposure to between 10 a.m. and 2 p.m., when the sun's rays are strongest.

en: Limit time in the sun between 10 a.m. and 2 p.m., when the sun's rays are most intense.
bad_en: Limit time in the sun between 10 a.m. and 2 p.m., when the sun's rays are least intense.

back: Limit sun exposure to between 10 a.m. and 2 p.m., when the sun is at its weakest.

en: Move the worker to a shaded, cool area.

en: Reapply sunscreen at least every two hours, and more often if you're sweating or swimming.

en: Reapply sunscreen at least every two hours, and more often if you're sweating or swimming.

back: Reapply sunscreen at least every two hours, or less frequently if you sweat or swim.

en: Raw meat, poultry, seafood, and eggs can spread germs to ready-to-eat food unless you keep them separate.
bad_en: Raw meat, poultry, seafood, and eggs can spread germs to ready-to-eat food even if you keep them separate.
translation: 生肉、家禽、海鲜和鸡蛋可能会将细菌传播到即食食品中，除非将它们分开存放。
back: Raw meat, poultry, seafood and eggs can spread bacteria to ready-to-eat foods unless they are stored separately.

back: Raw meat, poultry, seafood and eggs can spread bacteria to ready-to-eat foods, even if stored separately.

bad_en: Unless you drink alcoholic beverages, it's safer to eat some food at the same time.

en: If the food is exposed to temperatures above 90°F, refrigerate it within 1 hour.
bad_en: Unless the food is exposed to temperatures above 90°F, refrigerate it within 1 hour.
translation: 如果食物暴露在 90°F 以上的温度下，请在 1 小时内冷藏。
back: If food is exposed to temperatures above 90°F, refrigerate within 1 hour.

translation: 除非食物暴露在 90°F 以上的温度下，否则请在 1 小时内冷藏。
back: Refrigerate within 1 hour unless food has been exposed to temperatures above 90°F.

en: Ask a doctor before use if you are taking a diuretic.
bad_en: Ask a doctor before use unless you are taking a diuretic.
translation: 如果您正在服用利尿剂，请在使用前咨询医生。
back: If you are taking diuretics, consult your doctor before use.

back: Unless you are taking diuretics, consult your doctor before use.

bad_en: Stop use and ask a doctor if pain gets worse and lasts more than 10 days.
translation: 如果疼痛加剧或持续超过 10 天，请停止使用并询问医生。
back: If pain worsens or lasts more than 10 days, discontinue use and ask your doctor.

en: Stop use and ask a doctor if pain gets worse or lasts more than 10 days.

translation: 如果疼痛加剧并持续超过 10 天，请停止使用并询问医生。
back: If pain worsens and lasts more than 10 days, discontinue use and ask your doctor.

en: The risk is higher if you use more than directed or for longer than directed.
bad_en: The risk is higher only if you use more than directed and for longer than directed.
translation: 如果您使用超过指示的次数或时间超过指示的时间，风险会更高。
back: The risk is higher if you use more or for longer than directed.

back: The risk is only higher if you use it more often and for longer than directed.

en: If a food is recalled, throw it away.
bad_en: Unless a food is recalled, throw it away.

en: Reapply sunscreen every two hours, and more often if you're sweating or swimming.
bad_en: Reapply sunscreen every two hours, and more often unless you're sweating or swimming.

en: Reapply sunscreen every two hours, and more often if you're sweating or swimming.

en: If your blood glucose is below your target, eat or drink 15 to 20 grams of carbohydrates right away.
bad_en: Unless your blood glucose is below your target, eat or drink 15 to 20 grams of carbohydrates right away.
translation: 如果您的血糖低于目标，请立即吃或喝 15 至 20 克碳水化合物。
back: If your blood sugar is below your goal, eat or drink 15 to 20 grams of carbohydrates right away.

en: If your blood glucose is below your target, eat or drink 15 to 20 grams of carbohydrates right away.

back: Unless your blood sugar is below your goal, eat or drink 15 to 20 grams of carbohydrates immediately.

en: Never leave perishable food out for more than 2 hours, or 1 hour if it is exposed to temperatures above 90°F.
bad_en: Never leave perishable food out for more than 2 hours, or 1 hour unless it is exposed to temperatures above 90°F.
translation: 切勿将易腐烂的食物放在外面超过 2 小时，如果暴露在 90°F 以上的温度下，则不得放置超过 1 小时。
back: Never leave perishable food out for more than 2 hours, or more than 1 hour if exposed to temperatures above 90°F.

en: Never leave perishable food out for more than 2 hours, or 1 hour if it is exposed to temperatures above 90°F.

translation: 切勿将易腐烂食品放置超过 2 小时或 1 小时，除非暴露在 90°F 以上的温度下。
back: Never leave perishable food for more than 2 hours or 1 hour unless exposed to temperatures above 90°F.

en: Stay with the worker until emergency medical services arrive.
bad_en: The worker should stay with you until emergency medical services arrive.
translation: 留在工人身边，直到紧急医疗服务到达。
back: Remain with the worker until emergency medical services arrive.

back: The staff member should remain with you until emergency medical services arrive.

en: Ask your health care team if any of your diabetes medicines can cause low blood glucose.
bad_en: Your health care team will ask you if any of their medicines can cause low blood glucose.
translation: 询问您的医疗保健团队您的任何糖尿病药物是否会导致低血糖。
back: Ask your health care team if any of your diabetes medications can cause low blood sugar.

en: Ask your health care team if any of your diabetes medicines can cause low blood glucose.

en: Ask a doctor before applying sunscreen to children under six months of age.
bad_en: A doctor should ask you before applying sunscreen to children under six months of age.
translation: 给六个月以下的儿童涂抹防晒霜之前请先咨询医生。

back: Your doctor should ask you before using sunscreen on children under six months of age.

en: FDA recommends that infants be kept out of the sun between 10 a.m. and 2 p.m.
bad_en: FDA recommends that older adults be kept out of the sun between 10 a.m. and 2 p.m.

en: Move the worker to a shaded, cool area.

en: If you have kidney disease, don't drink orange juice.

back: Do not drink orange juice if you have kidney disease.

bad_en: Your health care team will ask you how they can prevent and treat symptoms of low blood glucose.

en: Do not use if you have ever had an allergic reaction to any other pain reliever.
bad_en: Do not use if your parent has ever had an allergic reaction to any other pain reliever.

en: Wash your hands with soap and water before and after handling raw chicken.
bad_en: Wash the chicken with soap and water before and after handling it.
translation: 在处理生鸡肉之前和之后用肥皂和水洗手。
back: Wash your hands with soap and water before and after handling raw chicken.

en: Wash your hands with soap and water before and after handling raw chicken.

translation: 在处理鸡肉之前和之后用肥皂和水清洗鸡肉。

en: A refund is due within 7 business days after you reject an offer if you paid for the ticket with a credit card.
bad_en: A refund is due within 17 business days after you reject an offer if you paid for the ticket with a credit card.
translation: 如果您使用信用卡支付机票，则应在拒绝报价后 7 个工作日内退款。
back: If you paid for your ticket with a credit card, the refund is due within 7 working days of rejecting the offer.

en: A refund is due within 7 business days after you reject an offer if you paid for the ticket with a credit card.
bad_en: A refund is due within 17 business days after you reject an offer if you paid for the ticket with a credit card.
translation: 如果您使用信用卡支付机票，则应在拒绝报价后 17 个工作日内退款。
back: If you paid for your ticket with a credit card, the refund is due within 17 working days of rejecting the offer.

en: A refund is due within 20 calendar days if you paid with another form of payment, such as a check or cash.
bad_en: A refund is due within 60 calendar days if you paid with another form of payment, such as a check or cash.
translation: 如果您使用其他付款方式（例如支票或现金）付款，则应在 20 个日历日内退款。
back: If you paid using another payment method (such as check or cash), your refund should be issued within 20 calendar days.

en: A refund is due within 20 calendar days if you paid with another form of payment, such as a check or cash.
bad_en: A refund is due within 60 calendar days if you paid with another form of payment, such as a check or cash.
translation: 如果您使用其他付款方式（例如支票或现金）付款，则应在 60 个日历日内退款。
back: If you paid using another payment method (such as check or cash), your refund is due within 60 calendar days.

en: A flight is significantly delayed if you arrive 3 hours or more later than scheduled on a domestic itinerary.
bad_en: A flight is significantly delayed if you arrive 5 hours or more later than scheduled on a domestic itinerary.
translation: 如果您比国内行程中的预定时间晚 3 小时或更长时间抵达，航班就会严重延误。
back: If you arrive 3 hours or more later than scheduled on your domestic itinerary, your flight will be severely delayed.

en: A flight is significantly delayed if you arrive 3 hours or more later than scheduled on a domestic itinerary.
bad_en: A flight is significantly delayed if you arrive 5 hours or more later than scheduled on a domestic itinerary.
translation: 如果您比国内行程中的预定时间晚 5 小时或更长时间抵达，航班就会严重延误。
back: If you arrive 5 hours or more later than scheduled on your domestic itinerary, your flight will be severely delayed.

en: For international itineraries, a significant delay means arriving 6 hours or more late.
bad_en: For international itineraries, a significant delay means arriving 12 hours or more late.
translation: 对于国际行程，严重延误意味着迟到 6 小时或更长时间。
back: For international travel, a severe delay means being 6 hours or more late.

en: For international itineraries, a significant delay means arriving 6 hours or more late.
bad_en: For international itineraries, a significant delay means arriving 12 hours or more late.
translation: 对于国际行程，严重延误意味着迟到 12 小时或更长时间。
back: For international travel, severe delays mean arriving 12 hours or more late.

en: Passengers are entitled to a refund of their checked bag fee if it is not delivered within 12 hours of their domestic flight arriving at the gate.
bad_en: Passengers are entitled to a refund of their checked bag fee if it is not delivered within 24 hours of their domestic flight arriving at the gate.
translation: 如果国内航班到达登机口后 12 小时内未交付行李，乘客有权退还托运行李费用。
back: Passengers on domestic flights are entitled to a refund of the checked baggage fee if the baggage is not delivered within 12 hours of arrival at the gate.

en: Passengers are entitled to a refund of their checked bag fee if it is not delivered within 12 hours of their domestic flight arriving at the gate.
bad_en: Passengers are entitled to a refund of their checked bag fee if it is not delivered within 24 hours of their domestic flight arriving at the gate.
translation: 如果国内航班到达登机口后 24 小时内未交付行李，乘客有权退还托运行李费用。
back: Passengers on domestic flights are entitled to a refund of the checked baggage fee if the baggage is not delivered within 24 hours of arrival at the gate.

en: Eligible employees may take up to 12 workweeks of leave in a 12-month period.
bad_en: Eligible employees may take up to 16 workweeks of leave in a 12-month period.
translation: 符合资格的员工在 12 个月内最多可​​以休 12 个工作周的假期。
back: Eligible employees can take up to 12 work weeks of vacation in a 12-month period.

en: Eligible employees may take up to 12 workweeks of leave in a 12-month period.
bad_en: Eligible employees may take up to 16 workweeks of leave in a 12-month period.
translation: 符合资格的员工在 12 个月内最多可​​以休 16 个工作周的假期。
back: Eligible employees can take up to 16 work weeks of vacation in a 12-month period.

en: Employees must have at least 1,250 hours of service with the employer during the 12 months before their leave starts.
bad_en: Employees must have at least 2,250 hours of service with the employer during the 12 months before their leave starts.
translation: 雇员在休假开始前的 12 个月内必须为雇主工作至少 1,250 小时。
back: The employee must have worked at least 1,250 hours for the employer in the 12 months before the leave begins.

en: Employees must have at least 1,250 hours of service with the employer during the 12 months before their leave starts.
bad_en: Employees must have at least 2,250 hours of service with the employer during the 12 months before their leave starts.
translation: 雇员在休假开始前的 12 个月内必须为雇主工作至少 2,250 小时。
back: The employee must have worked at least 2,250 hours for the employer in the 12 months before the leave begins.

en: The employee must work at a location where the employer has at least 50 employees within 75 miles.
bad_en: The employee must work at a location where the employer has at least 15 employees within 75 miles.
translation: 雇员必须在雇主 75 英里范围内至少有 50 名雇员的地点工作。
back: Employees must work at a location with at least 50 employees within 75 miles of the employer.

en: The employee must work at a location where the employer has at least 50 employees within 75 miles.

translation: 雇员必须在雇主 75 英里范围内至少有 15 名雇员的地点工作。
back: Employees must work at a location with at least 15 employees within 75 miles of the employer.

en: Keep records for 3 years if none of the special situations apply to you.

translation: 如果您没有特殊情况，则将记录保留 3 年。
back: If you have no special circumstances, keep records for 3 years.

en: Keep records for 3 years if none of the special situations apply to you.
bad_en: Keep records for 2 years if none of the special situations apply to you.
translation: 如果您没有特殊情况，则将记录保留 2 年。
back: If you have no special circumstances, keep records for 2 years.

en: Liquids in carry-on bags are limited to containers of 3.4 ounces or less per item.
bad_en: Liquids in carry-on bags are limited to containers of 6.8 ounces or less per item.
translation: 随身行李中的液体仅限于每件 3.4 盎司或以下的容器。
back: Liquids in carry-on baggage are limited to containers 3.4 ounces or less per item.

en: Liquids in carry-on bags are limited to containers of 3.4 ounces or less per item.
bad_en: Liquids in carry-on bags are limited to containers of 6.8 ounces or less per item.
translation: 随身行李中的液体仅限于每件 6.8 盎司或以下的容器。
back: Liquids in carry-on baggage are limited to containers 6.8 ounces or less per item.

translation: 供应商通常必须在收到争议后 30 天内进行调查并做出回应。

translation: 除非您选择乘坐严重延误的航班，否则您无权获得退款。
back: You are not entitled to a refund unless you choose to take a severely delayed flight.

bad_en: Unless the downgraded passenger continues to travel, the airline must refund the difference between the original fare and the lower fare.
translation: 如果降级旅客继续旅行，航空公司必须退还原票价与较低票价之间的差额。
back: If a downgraded passenger continues to travel, the airline must refund the difference between the original fare and the lower fare.

back: Airlines must refund the difference between the original fare and the lower fare unless the downgraded passenger continues traveling.

en: Passengers can get their bag fee refunded if the bag is not delivered within 12 hours.

translation: 如果行李在 12 小时内未送达，乘客可以退还行李费。

back: Passengers can receive a refund for their baggage fees unless the bag is not delivered within 12 hours.

bad_en: To be eligible, employees must have at least 1,250 hours of service or work at a location with at least 50 employees within 75 miles.
translation: 要符合资格，员工必须工作至少 1,250 小时，并且在 75 英里范围内至少有 50 名员工的地点工作。
back: To qualify, employees must work at least 1,250 hours and work at a location with at least 50 employees within 75 miles.

translation: يجب أن تخبرك شركات الطيران بأنه يحق لك استرداد أموالك ما لم تقبل عرضها.
back: Airlines must tell you that you are entitled to a refund unless you accept their offer.

en: Keep employment tax records for 4 years after the date the tax becomes due or is paid, whichever is later.
bad_en: Keep employment tax records for 4 years after the date the tax becomes due and is paid.
translation: احتفظ بسجلات ضريبة العمل لمدة 4 سنوات بعد تاريخ استحقاق الضريبة أو دفعها، أيهما أقرب.
back: Keep business tax records for 4 years after the date the tax is due or paid, whichever comes first.

en: Keep employment tax records for 4 years after the date the tax becomes due or is paid, whichever is later.
bad_en: Keep employment tax records for 4 years after the date the tax becomes due and is paid.
translation: احتفظ بسجلات ضريبة العمل لمدة 4 سنوات بعد تاريخ استحقاق الضريبة ودفعها.
back: Keep employment tax records for 4 years after the date the tax is due and paid.

en: A refund is due within 20 calendar days if you paid with another form of payment, such as a check or cash.
bad_en: A refund is due within 20 calendar days unless you paid with another form of payment, such as a check or cash.
translation: يستحق استرداد المبلغ خلال 20 يومًا تقويميًا إذا كنت قد دفعت بطريقة دفع أخرى، مثل شيك أو نقدًا.
back: A refund is due within 20 calendar days if you paid with another payment method, such as a check or cash.

en: A refund is due within 20 calendar days if you paid with another form of payment, such as a check or cash.
bad_en: A refund is due within 20 calendar days unless you paid with another form of payment, such as a check or cash.
translation: يجب استرداد المبلغ خلال 20 يومًا تقويميًا ما لم تدفع بطريقة دفع أخرى، مثل شيك أو نقدًا.
back: Your refund must be made within 20 calendar days unless you pay by another payment method, such as a check or cash.

en: Airlines must issue refunds within seven business days for credit card purchases.
bad_en: Passengers must pay the airline back within seven business days for credit card purchases.
translation: يجب على شركات الطيران إصدار المبالغ المستردة خلال سبعة أيام عمل لعمليات الشراء ببطاقات الائتمان.
back: Airlines must issue refunds within seven business days for credit card purchases.

en: Airlines must issue refunds within seven business days for credit card purchases.
bad_en: Passengers must pay the airline back within seven business days for credit card purchases.
translation: يجب على الركاب السداد لشركة الطيران خلال سبعة أيام عمل مقابل عمليات الشراء ببطاقات الائتمان.
back: Passengers must pay the airline within seven business days for credit card purchases.

en: Airlines must let you know that you are entitled to a refund.
bad_en: You must let the airline know that it is entitled to a refund.
translation: يجب أن تعلمك شركات الطيران بأنه يحق لك استرداد أموالك.
back: Airlines should inform you that you are entitled to a refund.

en: Airlines must let you know that you are entitled to a refund.
bad_en: You must let the airline know that it is entitled to a refund.
translation: يجب عليك إبلاغ شركة الطيران بأنه يحق لها استرداد المبلغ المدفوع.
back: You must inform the airline that you are entitled to a refund.

en: Employees must communicate with their employer about their leave needs.
bad_en: Employers must communicate with their employees about their own leave needs.
translation: يجب على الموظفين التواصل مع صاحب العمل بشأن احتياجات إجازتهم.
back: Employees should communicate their leave needs with their employer.

en: Employees must communicate with their employer about their leave needs.
bad_en: Employers must communicate with their employees about their own leave needs.
translation: يجب على أصحاب العمل التواصل مع موظفيهم بشأن احتياجات الإجازة الخاصة بهم.
back: Employers should communicate with their employees about their leave needs.

en: Employers are required to provide FMLA leave where all requirements are met.
bad_en: Employees are required to provide FMLA leave where all requirements are met.
translation: يتعين على أصحاب العمل تقديم إجازة FMLA حيث يتم استيفاء جميع المتطلبات.
back: Employers are required to provide FMLA leave where all requirements are met.

en: Employers are required to provide FMLA leave where all requirements are met.
bad_en: Employees are required to provide FMLA leave where all requirements are met.
translation: يُطلب من الموظفين تقديم إجازة FMLA حيث يتم استيفاء جميع المتطلبات.
back: Employees are required to submit FMLA leave where all requirements are met.

en: A family member of a covered servicemember may take up to 26 workweeks of leave to care for the servicemember.
bad_en: A covered servicemember may take up to 26 workweeks of leave to care for a family member.
translation: يجوز لأحد أفراد عائلة أحد أفراد الخدمة المشمولين بالتغطية أن يأخذ ما يصل إلى 26 أسبوع عمل إجازة لرعاية عضو الخدمة.
back: A family member of a covered service member may take up to 26 work weeks of leave to care for the service member.

en: A family member of a covered servicemember may take up to 26 workweeks of leave to care for the servicemember.
bad_en: A covered servicemember may take up to 26 workweeks of leave to care for a family member.
translation: يجوز لعضو الخدمة المغطى أن يأخذ ما يصل إلى 26 أسبوع عمل من الإجازة لرعاية أحد أفراد الأسرة.
back: A covered service member may take up to 26 work weeks of leave to care for a family member.

en: Furnishers must investigate and respond to your dispute within 30 days.
bad_en: You must investigate and respond to the furnisher's dispute within 30 days.
translation: يجب على مقدمي الأثاث التحقيق في نزاعك والرد عليه في غضون 30 يومًا.
back: Furniture Providers must investigate and respond to your dispute within 30 days.

en: Furnishers must investigate and respond to your dispute within 30 days.
bad_en: You must investigate and respond to the furnisher's dispute within 30 days.
translation: يجب عليك التحقيق في نزاع المُجهز والرد عليه في غضون 30 يومًا.
back: You must investigate and respond to the Supplier Dispute within 30 days.

en: The furnisher must update or remove the information and notify all the credit reporting companies.
bad_en: The credit reporting companies must update or remove the information and notify the furnisher.
translation: يجب على مقدم الخدمة تحديث المعلومات أو إزالتها وإخطار جميع شركات إعداد التقارير الائتمانية.
back: The service provider must update or remove the information and notify all credit reporting companies.

en: The furnisher must update or remove the information and notify all the credit reporting companies.
bad_en: The credit reporting companies must update or remove the information and notify the furnisher.
translation: يجب على شركات إعداد التقارير الائتمانية تحديث المعلومات أو إزالتها وإخطار مقدم الخدمة.
back: Credit reporting companies must update or remove the information and notify the service provider.

en: The credit reporting companies must update your credit reports.
bad_en: You must update the credit reporting companies' records.
translation: يجب على شركات إعداد التقارير الائتمانية تحديث تقارير الائتمان الخاصة بك.
back: Credit reporting companies must update your credit reports.

en: The credit reporting companies must update your credit reports.
bad_en: You must update the credit reporting companies' records.
translation: يجب عليك تحديث سجلات شركات التقارير الائتمانية.
back: You should update your credit reporting companies' records.

en: The items inside the secure bags must be screened and cleared by TSA.
bad_en: The items inside the secure bags must be screened and cleared by the passenger.
translation: يجب فحص العناصر الموجودة داخل الأكياس الآمنة وتخليصها من قبل إدارة أمن المواصلات (TSA).
back: Items inside secure bags must be checked and cleared by the Transportation Security Administration (TSA).

en: The items inside the secure bags must be screened and cleared by TSA.
bad_en: The items inside the secure bags must be screened and cleared by the passenger.
translation: يجب أن يتم فحص العناصر الموجودة داخل الحقائب الآمنة وتخليصها من قبل الراكب.
back: Items inside secure baggage must be checked and cleared by the passenger.

en: If the downgraded passenger continues to travel, the airline must refund the fare difference to the passenger.
bad_en: If the downgraded passenger continues to travel, the passenger must pay the fare difference to the airline.
translation: إذا استمر الراكب الذي تم تخفيض درجته في السفر، فيجب على شركة الطيران إعادة فرق السعر إلى الراكب.
back: If the downgraded passenger continues to travel, the airline must refund the fare difference to the passenger.

en: If the downgraded passenger continues to travel, the airline must refund the fare difference to the passenger.
bad_en: If the downgraded passenger continues to travel, the passenger must pay the fare difference to the airline.
translation: إذا استمر الراكب الذي تم تخفيض درجته في السفر، فيجب على الراكب دفع فرق السعر لشركة الطيران.
back: If the downgraded passenger continues to travel, the passenger must pay the fare difference to the airline.

en: You must keep records for 3 years.
bad_en: The IRS keeps your records for 3 years.
translation: يجب عليك الاحتفاظ بالسجلات لمدة 3 سنوات.
back: You must keep records for 3 years.

en: You must keep records for 3 years.
bad_en: The IRS keeps your records for 3 years.
translation: تحتفظ مصلحة الضرائب الأمريكية بسجلاتك لمدة 3 سنوات.
back: The IRS keeps your records for 3 years.

en: You can renew your passport by mail if it was issued when you were 16 or older.
bad_en: Your parent must renew your passport by mail if it was issued when you were 16 or older.
translation: يمكنك تجديد جواز سفرك عن طريق البريد إذا تم إصداره عندما كان عمرك 16 عامًا أو أكثر.
back: You can renew your passport by mail if it was issued when you were 16 or over.

en: You can renew your passport by mail if it was issued when you were 16 or older.
bad_en: Your parent must renew your passport by mail if it was issued when you were 16 or older.
translation: يجب على والدك تجديد جواز سفرك عن طريق البريد إذا تم إصداره عندما كان عمرك 16 عامًا أو أكثر.
back: Your parent must renew your passport by mail if it was issued when you were 16 or over.

en: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 20 seconds before and after handling raw chicken.
bad_en: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 5 seconds before and after handling raw chicken.
translation: कच्चे चिकन को छूने से पहले और बाद में अपने हाथों को कम से कम 20 सेकंड तक साबुन और पानी से धोएं।
back: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 20 seconds before and after touching raw chicken.

en: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 20 seconds before and after handling raw chicken.
bad_en: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 5 seconds before and after handling raw chicken.
translation: कच्चे चिकन को छूने से पहले और बाद में अपने हाथों को साबुन और पानी से कम से कम 5 सेकंड तक धोएं।
back: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 5 seconds before and after touching raw chicken.

en: Never leave perishable food out for more than 2 hours.
bad_en: Never leave perishable food out for more than 4 hours.
translation: खराब होने वाले भोजन को 2 घंटे से अधिक समय तक बाहर न रखें।
back: Do not leave perishable food out for more than 2 hours.

en: Never leave perishable food out for more than 2 hours.
bad_en: Never leave perishable food out for more than 4 hours.
translation: खराब होने वाले भोजन को 4 घंटे से अधिक समय तक बाहर न रखें।
back: Do not leave perishable food out for more than 4 hours.

en: If the food is exposed to temperatures above 90°F, like a hot car or picnic, refrigerate it within 1 hour.
bad_en: If the food is exposed to temperatures above 90°F, like a hot car or picnic, refrigerate it within 3 hours.
translation: यदि भोजन 90°F से अधिक तापमान के संपर्क में है, जैसे गर्म कार या पिकनिक, तो इसे 1 घंटे के भीतर ठंडा करें।
back: If food is exposed to temperatures above 90°F, such as a hot car or picnic, refrigerate it within 1 hour.

en: If the food is exposed to temperatures above 90°F, like a hot car or picnic, refrigerate it within 1 hour.
bad_en: If the food is exposed to temperatures above 90°F, like a hot car or picnic, refrigerate it within 3 hours.
translation: यदि भोजन 90°F से अधिक तापमान के संपर्क में है, जैसे गर्म कार या पिकनिक, तो इसे 3 घंटे के भीतर ठंडा करें।
back: If food is exposed to temperatures over 90°F, such as a hot car or picnic, refrigerate it within 3 hours.

en: Keep your refrigerator at 40°F or below and your freezer at 0°F or below.
bad_en: Keep your refrigerator at 50°F or below and your freezer at 0°F or below.
translation: अपने रेफ्रिजरेटर को 40°F या उससे नीचे और अपने फ्रीजर को 0°F या उससे नीचे रखें।
back: Keep your refrigerator at 40°F or below and your freezer at 0°F or below.

en: Keep your refrigerator at 40°F or below and your freezer at 0°F or below.
bad_en: Keep your refrigerator at 50°F or below and your freezer at 0°F or below.
translation: अपने रेफ्रिजरेटर को 50°F या उससे नीचे और अपने फ्रीजर को 0°F या उससे नीचे रखें।
back: Keep your refrigerator at 50°F or below and your freezer at 0°F or below.

en: Cook poultry to a safe minimum internal temperature of 165°F, as measured with a food thermometer.
bad_en: Cook poultry to a safe minimum internal temperature of 145°F, as measured with a food thermometer.
translation: पोल्ट्री को खाद्य थर्मामीटर से मापे गए 165°F के सुरक्षित न्यूनतम आंतरिक तापमान पर पकाएं।
back: Cook poultry to a safe minimum internal temperature of 165°F as measured with a food thermometer.

en: Cook poultry to a safe minimum internal temperature of 165°F, as measured with a food thermometer.
bad_en: Cook poultry to a safe minimum internal temperature of 145°F, as measured with a food thermometer.
translation: पोल्ट्री को खाद्य थर्मामीटर से मापे गए 145°F के सुरक्षित न्यूनतम आंतरिक तापमान पर पकाएं।
back: Cook poultry to a safe minimum internal temperature of 145°F as measured with a food thermometer.

en: Allow the meat to rest for 3 minutes before carving or eating.
bad_en: Allow the meat to rest for 30 minutes before carving or eating.
translation: मांस को तराशने या खाने से पहले 3 मिनट तक आराम करने दें।
back: Let the meat rest for 3 minutes before carving or eating.

en: Allow the meat to rest for 3 minutes before carving or eating.
bad_en: Allow the meat to rest for 30 minutes before carving or eating.
translation: मांस को तराशने या खाने से पहले 30 मिनट तक आराम करने दें।
back: Let the meat rest for 30 minutes before carving or eating.

en: If your blood glucose is less than 70 mg/dL, eat or drink 15 to 20 grams of glucose or carbohydrates right away.
bad_en: If your blood glucose is less than 50 mg/dL, eat or drink 15 to 20 grams of glucose or carbohydrates right away.
translation: यदि आपका रक्त ग्लूकोज 70 मिलीग्राम/डीएल से कम है, तो तुरंत 15 से 20 ग्राम ग्लूकोज या कार्बोहाइड्रेट खाएं या पिएं।
back: If your blood glucose is less than 70 mg/dL, eat or drink 15 to 20 grams of glucose or carbohydrate immediately.

en: If your blood glucose is less than 70 mg/dL, eat or drink 15 to 20 grams of glucose or carbohydrates right away.
bad_en: If your blood glucose is less than 50 mg/dL, eat or drink 15 to 20 grams of glucose or carbohydrates right away.
translation: यदि आपका रक्त ग्लूकोज 50 मिलीग्राम/डीएल से कम है, तो तुरंत 15 से 20 ग्राम ग्लूकोज या कार्बोहाइड्रेट खाएं या पिएं।
back: If your blood glucose is less than 50 mg/dL, eat or drink 15 to 20 grams of glucose or carbohydrate immediately.

en: Drink half a cup, or 4 ounces, of fruit juice to treat low blood glucose.
bad_en: Drink two cups, or 16 ounces, of fruit juice to treat low blood glucose.
translation: निम्न रक्त शर्करा के इलाज के लिए आधा कप या 4 औंस फलों का रस पियें।
back: Drink half a cup or 4 ounces of fruit juice to treat low blood sugar.

en: Drink half a cup, or 4 ounces, of fruit juice to treat low blood glucose.
bad_en: Drink two cups, or 16 ounces, of fruit juice to treat low blood glucose.
translation: निम्न रक्त शर्करा के इलाज के लिए दो कप या 16 औंस फलों का रस पियें।
back: Drink two cups or 16 ounces of fruit juice to treat low blood sugar.

en: Increasing your physical activity can lower your blood glucose level for up to 24 hours after the activity.
bad_en: Increasing your physical activity can lower your blood glucose level for up to 2 hours after the activity.
translation: अपनी शारीरिक गतिविधि बढ़ाने से गतिविधि के 24 घंटे बाद तक आपके रक्त शर्करा का स्तर कम हो सकता है।
back: Increasing your physical activity can lower your blood sugar levels for up to 24 hours after the activity.

en: Increasing your physical activity can lower your blood glucose level for up to 24 hours after the activity.
bad_en: Increasing your physical activity can lower your blood glucose level for up to 2 hours after the activity.
translation: अपनी शारीरिक गतिविधि बढ़ाने से गतिविधि के बाद 2 घंटे तक आपके रक्त शर्करा का स्तर कम हो सकता है।
back: Increasing your physical activity can lower your blood sugar levels for up to 2 hours after the activity.

en: Reapply sunscreen at least every two hours, and more often if you're sweating or swimming.
bad_en: Reapply sunscreen at least every five hours, and more often if you're sweating or swimming.
translation: कम से कम हर दो घंटे में सनस्क्रीन दोबारा लगाएं और अगर आपको पसीना आ रहा है या तैराकी कर रहे हैं तो अधिक बार सनस्क्रीन लगाएं।
back: Reapply sunscreen at least every two hours and more often if you're sweating or swimming.

en: Reapply sunscreen at least every two hours, and more often if you're sweating or swimming.
bad_en: Reapply sunscreen at least every five hours, and more often if you're sweating or swimming.
translation: कम से कम हर पांच घंटे में सनस्क्रीन दोबारा लगाएं, और यदि आपको पसीना आ रहा हो या तैराकी हो रही हो तो अधिक बार सनस्क्रीन लगाएं।
back: Reapply sunscreen at least every five hours, and more often if you're sweating or swimming.

en: Choose a broad-spectrum sunscreen with an SPF of at least 15.
bad_en: Choose a broad-spectrum sunscreen with an SPF of at least 5.
translation: कम से कम 15 एसपीएफ वाला ब्रॉड-स्पेक्ट्रम सनस्क्रीन चुनें।
back: Choose a broad-spectrum sunscreen with an SPF of at least 15.

en: Choose a broad-spectrum sunscreen with an SPF of at least 15.
bad_en: Choose a broad-spectrum sunscreen with an SPF of at least 5.
translation: कम से कम 5 एसपीएफ वाला ब्रॉड-स्पेक्ट्रम सनस्क्रीन चुनें।
back: Choose a broad-spectrum sunscreen with an SPF of at least 5.

en: The chance of severe stomach bleeding is higher if you are 60 or older.
bad_en: The chance of severe stomach bleeding is higher if you are 80 or older.
translation: यदि आपकी उम्र 60 वर्ष या उससे अधिक है तो पेट में गंभीर रक्तस्राव की संभावना अधिक है।
back: The chance of serious stomach bleeding is higher if you are 60 years of age or older.

en: The chance of severe stomach bleeding is higher if you are 60 or older.
bad_en: The chance of severe stomach bleeding is higher if you are 80 or older.
translation: यदि आपकी उम्र 80 वर्ष या उससे अधिक है तो पेट में गंभीर रक्तस्राव की संभावना अधिक है।
back: The chance of serious stomach bleeding is higher if you are 80 years of age or older.

en: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 20 seconds after handling raw chicken.
bad_en: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 20 minutes after handling raw chicken.
translation: कच्चे चिकन को छूने के बाद कम से कम 20 सेकंड तक अपने हाथ साबुन और पानी से धोएं।
back: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 20 seconds after touching raw chicken.

en: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 20 seconds after handling raw chicken.
bad_en: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 20 minutes after handling raw chicken.
translation: कच्चे चिकन को छूने के बाद कम से कम 20 मिनट तक अपने हाथ साबुन और पानी से धोएं।
back: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 20 minutes after touching raw chicken.

en: Refrigerate perishable food, such as meat, seafood, dairy and cooked leftovers, within 2 hours.
bad_en: Refrigerate perishable food, such as meat, seafood, dairy and cooked leftovers, within 2 days.
translation: मांस, समुद्री भोजन, डेयरी और पका हुआ बचा हुआ खाना जैसे खराब होने वाले भोजन को 2 घंटे के भीतर फ्रिज में रखें।
back: Refrigerate perishable food such as meat, seafood, dairy and cooked leftovers within 2 hours.

en: Refrigerate perishable food, such as meat, seafood, dairy and cooked leftovers, within 2 hours.
bad_en: Refrigerate perishable food, such as meat, seafood, dairy and cooked leftovers, within 2 days.
translation: मांस, समुद्री भोजन, डेयरी और पका हुआ बचा हुआ खाना जैसे खराब होने वाले भोजन को 2 दिनों के भीतर फ्रिज में रखें।
back: Refrigerate perishable food such as meat, seafood, dairy and cooked leftovers within 2 days.

en: If the food is exposed to temperatures above 90°F, refrigerate it within 1 hour.
bad_en: If the food is exposed to temperatures above 90°C, refrigerate it within 1 hour.
translation: यदि भोजन 90°F से अधिक तापमान के संपर्क में है, तो उसे 1 घंटे के भीतर रेफ्रिजरेटर में रख दें।
back: If food is exposed to temperatures above 90°F, refrigerate it within 1 hour.

en: If the food is exposed to temperatures above 90°F, refrigerate it within 1 hour.
bad_en: If the food is exposed to temperatures above 90°C, refrigerate it within 1 hour.
translation: यदि भोजन 90°C से ऊपर के तापमान के संपर्क में है, तो उसे 1 घंटे के भीतर रेफ्रिजरेटर में रख दें।
back: If food is exposed to temperatures above 90°C, refrigerate it within 1 hour.

en: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F.
bad_en: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°C.
translation: पोल्ट्री को 165°F के आंतरिक तापमान पर पकाएं।
back: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F.

en: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F.
bad_en: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°C.
translation: पोल्ट्री को 165°C के आंतरिक तापमान पर पकाएं।
back: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°C.

en: Let the meat rest for 3 minutes before carving or eating it.
bad_en: Let the meat rest for 3 hours before carving or eating it.
translation: मांस को तराशने या खाने से पहले 3 मिनट के लिए आराम दें।
back: Let the meat rest for 3 minutes before carving or eating.

en: Let the meat rest for 3 minutes before carving or eating it.
bad_en: Let the meat rest for 3 hours before carving or eating it.
translation: मांस को तराशने या खाने से पहले उसे 3 घंटे के लिए आराम दें।
back: Let the meat rest for 3 hours before carving or eating it.

en: If your blood glucose is below your target, take 15 to 20 grams of glucose or carbohydrates right away.
bad_en: If your blood glucose is below your target, take 15 to 20 milligrams of glucose or carbohydrates right away.
translation: यदि आपका रक्त ग्लूकोज आपके लक्ष्य से कम है, तो तुरंत 15 से 20 ग्राम ग्लूकोज या कार्बोहाइड्रेट लें।
back: If your blood glucose is below your goal, take 15 to 20 grams of glucose or carbohydrate immediately.

en: If your blood glucose is below your target, take 15 to 20 grams of glucose or carbohydrates right away.
bad_en: If your blood glucose is below your target, take 15 to 20 milligrams of glucose or carbohydrates right away.
translation: यदि आपका रक्त ग्लूकोज आपके लक्ष्य से कम है, तो तुरंत 15 से 20 मिलीग्राम ग्लूकोज या कार्बोहाइड्रेट लें।
back: If your blood glucose is below your target, take 15 to 20 mg of glucose or carbohydrate immediately.

en: Drink 4 ounces of fruit juice to treat low blood glucose.
bad_en: Drink 4 quarts of fruit juice to treat low blood glucose.
translation: निम्न रक्त शर्करा के इलाज के लिए 4 औंस फलों का रस पियें।
back: Drink 4 ounces of fruit juice to treat low blood sugar.

en: Drink 4 ounces of fruit juice to treat low blood glucose.
bad_en: Drink 4 quarts of fruit juice to treat low blood glucose.
translation: निम्न रक्त शर्करा के उपचार के लिए 4 क्वार्ट फलों का रस पियें।
back: To treat low blood sugar, drink 4 quarts of fruit juice.

en: Physical activity can lower your blood glucose for up to 24 hours afterward.
bad_en: Physical activity can lower your blood glucose for up to 24 days afterward.
translation: शारीरिक गतिविधि आपके रक्त शर्करा को 24 घंटे तक कम कर सकती है।
back: Physical activity can lower your blood sugar for up to 24 hours.

en: Physical activity can lower your blood glucose for up to 24 hours afterward.
bad_en: Physical activity can lower your blood glucose for up to 24 days afterward.
translation: शारीरिक गतिविधि आपके रक्त शर्करा को 24 दिनों तक कम कर सकती है।
back: Physical activity can lower your blood sugar for up to 24 days.

en: Reapply sunscreen every two hours when you are outdoors.
bad_en: Reapply sunscreen every two days when you are outdoors.
translation: जब आप बाहर हों तो हर दो घंटे में सनस्क्रीन दोबारा लगाएं।
back: Reapply sunscreen every two hours when you're outside.

en: Reapply sunscreen every two hours when you are outdoors.
bad_en: Reapply sunscreen every two days when you are outdoors.
translation: जब आप बाहर हों तो हर दो दिन में सनस्क्रीन दोबारा लगाएं।
back: Reapply sunscreen every two days when you're outside.

en: Apply sunscreen 15 minutes before sun exposure.
bad_en: Apply sunscreen 15 hours before sun exposure.
translation: धूप में निकलने से 15 मिनट पहले सनस्क्रीन लगाएं।
back: Apply sunscreen 15 minutes before going out in the sun.

en: Apply sunscreen 15 minutes before sun exposure.
bad_en: Apply sunscreen 15 hours before sun exposure.
translation: धूप में निकलने से 15 घंटे पहले सनस्क्रीन लगाएं।
back: Apply sunscreen 15 hours before going out in the sun.

en: An average-sized adult needs at least one ounce of sunscreen to cover the body from head to toe.
bad_en: An average-sized adult needs at least one pound of sunscreen to cover the body from head to toe.
translation: एक औसत आकार के वयस्क को शरीर को सिर से पैर तक ढकने के लिए कम से कम एक औंस सनस्क्रीन की आवश्यकता होती है।
back: An average-sized adult needs at least an ounce of sunscreen to cover the body from head to toe.

en: An average-sized adult needs at least one ounce of sunscreen to cover the body from head to toe.

translation: एक औसत आकार के वयस्क को शरीर को सिर से पैर तक ढकने के लिए कम से कम एक पाउंड सनस्क्रीन की आवश्यकता होती है।

en: Stop use and ask a doctor if pain gets worse or lasts more than 10 days.
bad_en: Stop use and ask a doctor if pain gets worse or lasts more than 10 weeks.
translation: यदि दर्द बदतर हो जाता है या 10 दिनों से अधिक समय तक रहता है तो उपयोग बंद कर दें और डॉक्टर से पूछें।
back: If pain gets worse or lasts more than 10 days stop use and ask a doctor.

translation: यदि दर्द बदतर हो जाता है या 10 सप्ताह से अधिक समय तक रहता है तो उपयोग बंद कर दें और डॉक्टर से पूछें।
back: If pain gets worse or lasts more than 10 weeks stop use and ask a doctor.

en: Never thaw food on the counter.
bad_en: Thaw food on the counter.
translation: भोजन को कभी भी काउंटर पर न पिघलाएं।
back: Never thaw food on the counter.

bad_en: Thaw food on the counter.
translation: काउंटर पर खाना पिघलाएँ।
back: Thaw food on the counter.

en: Raw chicken is ready to cook and doesn't need to be washed first.
bad_en: Raw chicken is ready to cook but needs to be washed first.
translation: कच्चा चिकन पकाने के लिए तैयार है और इसे पहले धोने की आवश्यकता नहीं है।
back: Raw chicken is ready to cook and does not need to be washed first.

en: Raw chicken is ready to cook and doesn't need to be washed first.
bad_en: Raw chicken is ready to cook but needs to be washed first.
translation: कच्चा चिकन पकाने के लिए तैयार है लेकिन पहले उसे धोना होगा।
back: Raw chicken is ready to cook but first it needs to be washed.

en: If you have kidney disease, don't drink orange juice, because it has a lot of potassium.
bad_en: If you have kidney disease, drink orange juice, because it has a lot of potassium.
translation: अगर आपको किडनी की बीमारी है तो संतरे का जूस न पिएं, क्योंकि इसमें पोटैशियम की मात्रा बहुत अधिक होती है।
back: If you have kidney disease, do not drink orange juice, because it contains too much potassium.

en: If you have kidney disease, don't drink orange juice, because it has a lot of potassium.
bad_en: If you have kidney disease, drink orange juice, because it has a lot of potassium.
translation: अगर आपको किडनी की बीमारी है तो संतरे का जूस पिएं, क्योंकि इसमें पोटैशियम भरपूर मात्रा में होता है।
back: If you have kidney disease then drink orange juice, because it is rich in potassium.

en: Sunscreen is not recommended for infants under six months old.
bad_en: Sunscreen is recommended for infants under six months old.
translation: छह महीने से कम उम्र के शिशुओं के लिए सनस्क्रीन की सिफारिश नहीं की जाती है।
back: Sunscreen is not recommended for infants under six months of age.

en: Sunscreen is not recommended for infants under six months old.

back: Sunscreen is recommended for infants under six months of age.

en: Spray sunscreens should never be applied directly to your face.
bad_en: Spray sunscreens should be applied directly to your face.
translation: स्प्रे सनस्क्रीन को कभी भी सीधे अपने चेहरे पर नहीं लगाना चाहिए।
back: Spray sunscreen should never be applied directly to your face.

en: Spray sunscreens should never be applied directly to your face.

translation: स्प्रे सनस्क्रीन सीधे आपके चेहरे पर लगाना चाहिए।
back: Spray sunscreen should be applied directly to your face.

en: Do not use if you have ever had an allergic reaction to any other pain reliever or fever reducer.
bad_en: Use it even if you have had an allergic reaction to another pain reliever or fever reducer.
translation: यदि आपको कभी किसी अन्य दर्द निवारक या बुखार कम करने वाली दवा से एलर्जी की प्रतिक्रिया हुई हो तो इसका उपयोग न करें।
back: Do not use if you have ever had an allergic reaction to any other pain reliever or fever reducer.

en: Do not use if you have ever had an allergic reaction to any other pain reliever or fever reducer.
bad_en: Use it even if you have had an allergic reaction to another pain reliever or fever reducer.
translation: यदि आपको किसी अन्य दर्द निवारक या बुखार कम करने वाली दवा से एलर्जी की प्रतिक्रिया हुई हो तो भी इसका उपयोग करें।
back: Use it even if you have had an allergic reaction to another pain reliever or fever reducer.

en: Stay with the worker until emergency medical services arrive.
bad_en: Do not stay with the worker until emergency medical services arrive.
translation: आपातकालीन चिकित्सा सेवाएँ आने तक कर्मचारी के साथ रहें।

back: Do not remain with the employee until emergency medical services arrive.

en: Never leave perishable food out for more than 2 hours.
bad_en: You can leave perishable food out for more than 2 hours.
translation: खराब होने वाले भोजन को 2 घंटे से अधिक समय तक बाहर न रखें।
back: Do not leave perishable food out for more than 2 hours.

en: Never leave perishable food out for more than 2 hours.
bad_en: You can leave perishable food out for more than 2 hours.
translation: आप खराब होने वाले भोजन को 2 घंटे से अधिक समय के लिए बाहर छोड़ सकते हैं।
back: You can leave perishable food out for more than 2 hours.

en: It is okay to put small portions of hot food in the refrigerator, since they will chill faster.
bad_en: It is not okay to put small portions of hot food in the refrigerator, even though they will chill faster.
translation: गर्म भोजन के छोटे हिस्से को रेफ्रिजरेटर में रखना ठीक है, क्योंकि वे तेजी से ठंडे होंगे।
back: It's okay to put small portions of hot food in the refrigerator, as they will cool faster.

en: It is okay to put small portions of hot food in the refrigerator, since they will chill faster.

en: If a food is recalled, throw it away.
bad_en: If a food is recalled, don't throw it away.
translation: यदि कोई खाना याद आ जाए तो उसे फेंक दें।
back: If you remember any food, throw it away.

en: If a food is recalled, throw it away.

en: Call 911 for emergency medical care.
bad_en: Do not call 911 for emergency medical care.
translation: आपातकालीन चिकित्सा देखभाल के लिए 911 पर कॉल करें।
back: Call 911 for emergency medical care.

back: To prevent low blood sugar, you should not eat breakfast before physical activity.

en: Keep your refrigerator at 40°F or below.

translation: अपने रेफ्रिजरेटर को 40°F या उससे नीचे रखें।

bad_en: The chance of stomach bleeding is higher if you are 60 or younger.

back: Stomach bleeding is more likely if you are 60 years of age or younger.

en: Apply sunscreen 15 minutes before sun exposure.

translation: यदि आपका रक्त ग्लूकोज आपके लक्ष्य से कम है, तो तुरंत 15 से 20 ग्राम ग्लूकोज लें।

en: Raw meat, poultry, seafood, and eggs can spread germs to ready-to-eat food unless you keep them separate.

translation: कच्चा मांस, मुर्गी पालन, समुद्री भोजन और अंडे खाने के लिए तैयार भोजन में रोगाणु फैला सकते हैं जब तक कि आप उन्हें अलग न रखें।

en: Raw meat, poultry, seafood, and eggs can spread germs to ready-to-eat food unless you keep them separate.

en: If the food is exposed to temperatures above 90°F, refrigerate it within 1 hour.
bad_en: Unless the food is exposed to temperatures above 90°F, refrigerate it within 1 hour.

translation: यदि आपने काफी देरी से उड़ान भरने का विकल्प चुना है, तो आप डीओटी नियमों के तहत रिफंड के हकदार नहीं हैं।
back: If you have opted for a significantly delayed flight, you are not entitled to a refund under DOT rules.

en: If you chose to take a significantly delayed flight, you are not entitled to a refund under DOT rules.
bad_en: If you chose to take a significantly delayed flight, you are entitled to a refund under DOT rules.

back: If you have opted for a significantly delayed flight, you are entitled to a refund under DOT rules.

en: An eligible employee may not take intermittent leave for the birth of a child unless the employer agrees.
bad_en: An eligible employee may take intermittent leave for the birth of a child unless the employer agrees.
translation: एक योग्य कर्मचारी बच्चे के जन्म के लिए तब तक रुक-रुक कर छुट्टी नहीं ले सकता जब तक कि नियोक्ता सहमत न हो।
back: An eligible employee cannot take intermittent leave for the birth of a child unless the employer agrees.

en: An eligible employee may not take intermittent leave for the birth of a child unless the employer agrees.
bad_en: An eligible employee may take intermittent leave for the birth of a child unless the employer agrees.
translation: एक पात्र कर्मचारी बच्चे के जन्म के लिए रुक-रुक कर छुट्टी ले सकता है जब तक कि नियोक्ता सहमत न हो।
back: An eligible employee may take intermittent leave for the birth of a child unless the employer agrees.

en: Employers are required to provide FMLA leave where all requirements are met.
bad_en: Employers are not required to provide FMLA leave where all requirements are met.
translation: नियोक्ताओं को एफएमएलए अवकाश प्रदान करना आवश्यक है जहां सभी आवश्यकताएं पूरी होती हैं।
back: Employers are required to provide FMLA leave where all requirements are met.

en: Employers are required to provide FMLA leave where all requirements are met.
bad_en: Employers are not required to provide FMLA leave where all requirements are met.
translation: जहां सभी आवश्यकताएं पूरी होती हैं वहां नियोक्ताओं को एफएमएलए अवकाश प्रदान करने की आवश्यकता नहीं होती है।
back: Employers are not required to provide FMLA leave where all requirements are met.

en: Keep records indefinitely if you do not file a return.
bad_en: Keep records indefinitely if you file a return.
translation: यदि आप रिटर्न दाखिल नहीं करते हैं तो रिकॉर्ड अनिश्चित काल तक रखें।
back: Keep records indefinitely if you don't file a return.

en: Keep records indefinitely if you do not file a return.
bad_en: Keep records indefinitely if you file a return.
translation: यदि आप रिटर्न दाखिल करते हैं तो रिकॉर्ड अनिश्चित काल तक रखें।
back: If you file a return, keep the records indefinitely.

en: When your records are no longer needed for tax purposes, do not discard them until you check whether you have to keep them longer.
bad_en: When your records are no longer needed for tax purposes, you can discard them without checking whether you have to keep them longer.
translation: जब आपके रिकॉर्ड की कर उद्देश्यों के लिए आवश्यकता नहीं रह जाती है, तो उन्हें तब तक न फेंकें जब तक कि आप यह जांच न कर लें कि आपको उन्हें लंबे समय तक रखना है या नहीं।
back: When your records are no longer needed for tax purposes, don't throw them away until you've checked whether you need to keep them for that long.

en: When your records are no longer needed for tax purposes, do not discard them until you check whether you have to keep them longer.
bad_en: When your records are no longer needed for tax purposes, you can discard them without checking whether you have to keep them longer.
translation: जब आपके रिकॉर्ड की कर उद्देश्यों के लिए आवश्यकता नहीं रह जाती है, तो आप यह जांच किए बिना उन्हें त्याग सकते हैं कि आपको उन्हें लंबे समय तक रखना है या नहीं।
back: When your records are no longer needed for tax purposes, you can discard them without checking whether you need to keep them for that long.

en: Pack items in containers larger than 3.4 ounces in checked baggage.

en: You are entitled to a refund if the airline cancelled your flight and you choose not to travel.
bad_en: You are entitled to a refund if the airline cancelled your flight and you choose to travel.
translation: यदि एयरलाइन ने आपकी उड़ान रद्द कर दी है और आप यात्रा नहीं करने का निर्णय लेते हैं तो आप धनवापसी के हकदार हैं।

en: You are entitled to a refund if the airline cancelled your flight and you choose not to travel.

back: If the airline has canceled your flight and you choose to travel you are entitled to a refund.

en: Airlines must let you know that you are entitled to a refund if you don't accept the offer.
bad_en: Airlines must let you know that you are entitled to a refund if you accept the offer.
translation: एयरलाइंस को आपको अवश्य बताना चाहिए कि यदि आप प्रस्ताव स्वीकार नहीं करते हैं तो आप धनवापसी के हकदार हैं।

en: A refund is due within 7 business days after you reject the airline's offer.
bad_en: A refund is due at least 7 business days after you reject the airline's offer.
translation: एयरलाइन के प्रस्ताव को अस्वीकार करने के बाद 7 व्यावसायिक दिनों के भीतर रिफंड देय होगा।
back: Refunds will be payable within 7 business days after the airline rejects the offer.

bad_en: A refund is due at least 7 business days after you reject the airline's offer.

back: Refunds are due at least 7 working days after the airline rejects the offer.

en: A flight is significantly changed if you arrive 3 hours or more later than scheduled.
bad_en: A flight is significantly changed if you arrive 3 hours or more earlier than scheduled.
translation: यदि आप निर्धारित समय से 3 घंटे या उससे अधिक देर से पहुंचते हैं तो उड़ान में महत्वपूर्ण परिवर्तन हो जाता है।
back: If you arrive 3 hours or more late than the scheduled time, the flight may be significantly changed.

back: If you arrive 3 hours or more before the scheduled time, the flight may be significantly changed.

en: Employees must have at least 1,250 hours of service during the 12 months before their leave starts.
bad_en: Employees must have at least 1,250 hours of service during the 12 months after their leave starts.
translation: कर्मचारियों को अपनी छुट्टी शुरू होने से पहले 12 महीनों के दौरान कम से कम 1,250 घंटे की सेवा करनी होगी।
back: Employees must have put in at least 1,250 hours of service during the 12 months before their leave begins.

en: Employees must have at least 1,250 hours of service during the 12 months before their leave starts.

back: Employees must provide a minimum of 1,250 hours of service during the 12 months following the start of their leave.

en: The employer must have at least 50 employees within 75 miles.

back: The employer must have at least 50 employees within 75 miles.

back: The employer must have a maximum of 50 employees within 75 miles.

en: Keep employment tax records for at least 4 years after the tax becomes due or is paid, whichever is later.

translation: कर देय होने या भुगतान होने के बाद, जो भी बाद में हो, कम से कम 4 वर्षों तक रोजगार कर रिकॉर्ड रखें।
