en: If you chose to take a significantly delayed flight, you are not entitled to a refund.
bad_en: Unless you chose to take a significantly delayed flight, you are not entitled to a refund.
translation: जब तक आपने काफी देरी से उड़ान भरने का विकल्प नहीं चुना, आप रिफंड के हकदार नहीं हैं।
back: Unless you chose to fly a significantly delayed flight, you are not entitled to a refund.

en: If the downgraded passenger continues to travel, the airline must refund the difference between the original fare and the lower fare.
bad_en: Unless the downgraded passenger continues to travel, the airline must refund the difference between the original fare and the lower fare.
translation: यदि डाउनग्रेड किया गया यात्री यात्रा करना जारी रखता है, तो एयरलाइन को मूल किराए और कम किराए के बीच का अंतर वापस करना होगा।
back: If the downgraded passenger continues to travel, the airline must refund the difference between the original fare and the reduced fare.

en: If the downgraded passenger continues to travel, the airline must refund the difference between the original fare and the lower fare.
bad_en: Unless the downgraded passenger continues to travel, the airline must refund the difference between the original fare and the lower fare.
translation: जब तक डाउनग्रेड किया गया यात्री यात्रा जारी रखता है, एयरलाइन को मूल किराए और निचले किराए के बीच का अंतर वापस करना होगा।
back: As long as the downgraded passenger continues the journey, the airline must refund the difference between the original fare and the lower fare.

en: Passengers can get their bag fee refunded if the bag is not delivered within 12 hours.
bad_en: Passengers can get their bag fee refunded unless the bag is not delivered within 12 hours.
translation: यदि बैग 12 घंटे के भीतर वितरित नहीं किया जाता है तो यात्री अपना बैग शुल्क वापस पा सकते हैं।
back: Passengers can get their bag fee refunded if the bag is not delivered within 12 hours.

en: Passengers can get their bag fee refunded if the bag is not delivered within 12 hours.
bad_en: Passengers can get their bag fee refunded unless the bag is not delivered within 12 hours.
translation: जब तक बैग 12 घंटे के भीतर डिलीवर नहीं हो जाता, यात्री अपना बैग शुल्क वापस पा सकते हैं।
back: As long as the bag is delivered within 12 hours, passengers can get their bag fee back.

en: To be eligible, employees must have at least 1,250 hours of service and work at a location with at least 50 employees within 75 miles.
bad_en: To be eligible, employees must have at least 1,250 hours of service or work at a location with at least 50 employees within 75 miles.
translation: पात्र होने के लिए, कर्मचारियों के पास कम से कम 1,250 घंटे की सेवा होनी चाहिए और 75 मील के भीतर कम से कम 50 कर्मचारियों वाले स्थान पर काम करना चाहिए।
back: To be eligible, employees must have at least 1,250 hours of service and work at a location with at least 50 employees within 75 miles.

en: To be eligible, employees must have at least 1,250 hours of service and work at a location with at least 50 employees within 75 miles.
bad_en: To be eligible, employees must have at least 1,250 hours of service or work at a location with at least 50 employees within 75 miles.
translation: पात्र होने के लिए, कर्मचारियों के पास कम से कम 1,250 घंटे की सेवा होनी चाहिए या 75 मील के भीतर कम से कम 50 कर्मचारियों वाले स्थान पर काम करना चाहिए।
back: To be eligible, employees must have at least 1,250 hours of service or work at a location with at least 50 employees within 75 miles.

en: An employee may not take intermittent leave for the birth of a child unless the employer agrees.
bad_en: An employee may not take intermittent leave for the birth of a child if the employer agrees.
translation: जब तक नियोक्ता सहमत न हो, कोई कर्मचारी बच्चे के जन्म के लिए रुक-रुक कर छुट्टी नहीं ले सकता है।
back: Unless the employer agrees, an employee cannot take intermittent leave for the birth of a child.

en: An employee may not take intermittent leave for the birth of a child unless the employer agrees.
bad_en: An employee may not take intermittent leave for the birth of a child if the employer agrees.
translation: यदि नियोक्ता सहमत हो तो कोई कर्मचारी बच्चे के जन्म के लिए रुक-रुक कर छुट्टी नहीं ले सकता है।
back: An employee cannot take intermittent leave for the birth of a child if the employer agrees.

en: Keep records for 7 years if you file a claim for a loss from worthless securities.
bad_en: Keep records for 7 years unless you file a claim for a loss from worthless securities.
translation: यदि आप बेकार प्रतिभूतियों से हानि के लिए दावा दायर करते हैं तो 7 वर्षों तक रिकॉर्ड रखें।
back: Keep records for 7 years if you file a claim for losses from worthless securities.

en: Keep records for 7 years if you file a claim for a loss from worthless securities.
bad_en: Keep records for 7 years unless you file a claim for a loss from worthless securities.
translation: जब तक आप बेकार प्रतिभूतियों से होने वाले नुकसान के लिए दावा दायर नहीं करते, तब तक 7 वर्षों तक रिकॉर्ड रखें।
back: Keep records for 7 years unless you file a claim for losses from worthless securities.

en: Keep records indefinitely if you do not file a return.
bad_en: Keep records indefinitely unless you do not file a return.
translation: यदि आप रिटर्न दाखिल नहीं करते हैं तो रिकॉर्ड अनिश्चित काल तक रखें।
back: Keep records indefinitely if you don't file a return.

en: Keep records indefinitely if you do not file a return.
bad_en: Keep records indefinitely unless you do not file a return.
translation: जब तक आप रिटर्न दाखिल नहीं करते, तब तक रिकॉर्ड अनिश्चित काल तक रखें।
back: Keep the records indefinitely, until you file a return.

en: If the information cannot be verified, the furnisher must update or remove it.
bad_en: Unless the information cannot be verified, the furnisher must update or remove it.
translation: यदि जानकारी सत्यापित नहीं की जा सकती है, तो फर्निशर को इसे अपडेट करना होगा या हटाना होगा।
back: If the information cannot be verified, the furnisher must update or delete it.

en: If the information cannot be verified, the furnisher must update or remove it.
bad_en: Unless the information cannot be verified, the furnisher must update or remove it.
translation: जब तक जानकारी सत्यापित नहीं की जा सकती, फर्निशर को इसे अपडेट करना होगा या हटाना होगा।
back: Unless the information can be verified, the furnisher must update or remove it.

en: Airlines must tell you that you are entitled to a refund if you don't accept their offer.
bad_en: Airlines must tell you that you are entitled to a refund unless you don't accept their offer.
translation: एयरलाइंस को आपको अवश्य बताना चाहिए कि यदि आप उनका प्रस्ताव स्वीकार नहीं करते हैं तो आप धनवापसी के हकदार हैं।
back: Airlines must tell you that you are entitled to a refund if you do not accept their offer.

en: Airlines must tell you that you are entitled to a refund if you don't accept their offer.
bad_en: Airlines must tell you that you are entitled to a refund unless you don't accept their offer.
translation: एयरलाइंस को आपको अवश्य बताना चाहिए कि जब तक आप उनका प्रस्ताव स्वीकार नहीं करते, तब तक आप रिफंड के हकदार हैं।
back: Airlines must tell you that you are entitled to a refund unless you accept their offer.

en: Keep employment tax records for 4 years after the date the tax becomes due or is paid, whichever is later.
bad_en: Keep employment tax records for 4 years after the date the tax becomes due and is paid.
translation: कर देय होने या भुगतान किए जाने की तारीख, जो भी बाद में हो, के बाद 4 वर्षों तक रोजगार कर रिकॉर्ड रखें।
back: Keep employment tax records for 4 years after the date the tax is due or paid, whichever is later.

en: Keep employment tax records for 4 years after the date the tax becomes due or is paid, whichever is later.
bad_en: Keep employment tax records for 4 years after the date the tax becomes due and is paid.
translation: कर देय होने और भुगतान की तारीख के बाद 4 वर्षों तक रोजगार कर रिकॉर्ड रखें।
back: Keep employment tax records for 4 years after the date the tax is due and paid.

en: A refund is due within 20 calendar days if you paid with another form of payment, such as a check or cash.
bad_en: A refund is due within 20 calendar days unless you paid with another form of payment, such as a check or cash.
translation: यदि आपने किसी अन्य प्रकार के भुगतान, जैसे चेक या नकद, से भुगतान किया है तो रिफंड 20 कैलेंडर दिनों के भीतर देय होगा।
back: If you paid by any other form of payment, such as check or cash, the refund will be due within 20 calendar days.

en: A refund is due within 20 calendar days if you paid with another form of payment, such as a check or cash.
bad_en: A refund is due within 20 calendar days unless you paid with another form of payment, such as a check or cash.
translation: रिफंड 20 कैलेंडर दिनों के भीतर देय होता है, जब तक कि आपने चेक या नकद जैसे किसी अन्य प्रकार के भुगतान से भुगतान नहीं किया हो।
back: Refunds are due within 20 calendar days, unless you paid by another form of payment such as check or cash.

en: Airlines must issue refunds within seven business days for credit card purchases.
bad_en: Passengers must pay the airline back within seven business days for credit card purchases.
translation: एयरलाइंस को क्रेडिट कार्ड से खरीदारी के लिए सात व्यावसायिक दिनों के भीतर रिफंड जारी करना होगा।
back: Airlines must issue refunds within seven business days for credit card purchases.

en: Airlines must issue refunds within seven business days for credit card purchases.
bad_en: Passengers must pay the airline back within seven business days for credit card purchases.
translation: यात्रियों को क्रेडिट कार्ड से खरीदारी के लिए सात व्यावसायिक दिनों के भीतर एयरलाइन को भुगतान करना होगा।
back: Passengers must pay the airline within seven business days for credit card purchases.

en: Airlines must let you know that you are entitled to a refund.
bad_en: You must let the airline know that it is entitled to a refund.
translation: एयरलाइंस को आपको अवश्य बताना चाहिए कि आप रिफंड के हकदार हैं।
back: Airlines must tell you that you are entitled to a refund.

en: Airlines must let you know that you are entitled to a refund.
bad_en: You must let the airline know that it is entitled to a refund.
translation: आपको एयरलाइन को अवश्य बताना चाहिए कि वह रिफंड का हकदार है।
back: You must tell the airline that you are entitled to a refund.

en: Employees must communicate with their employer about their leave needs.
bad_en: Employers must communicate with their employees about their own leave needs.
translation: कर्मचारियों को अपनी छुट्टी की जरूरतों के बारे में अपने नियोक्ता से अवश्य संवाद करना चाहिए।
back: Employees must communicate with their employer about their leave needs.

en: Employees must communicate with their employer about their leave needs.
bad_en: Employers must communicate with their employees about their own leave needs.
translation: नियोक्ताओं को अपने कर्मचारियों से उनकी छुट्टियों की जरूरतों के बारे में संवाद करना चाहिए।
back: Employers should communicate with their employees about their vacation needs.

en: Employers are required to provide FMLA leave where all requirements are met.
bad_en: Employees are required to provide FMLA leave where all requirements are met.
translation: नियोक्ताओं को एफएमएलए अवकाश प्रदान करना आवश्यक है जहां सभी आवश्यकताएं पूरी होती हैं।
back: Employers are required to provide FMLA leave where all requirements are met.

en: Employers are required to provide FMLA leave where all requirements are met.
bad_en: Employees are required to provide FMLA leave where all requirements are met.
translation: कर्मचारियों को एफएमएलए अवकाश प्रदान करना आवश्यक है जहां सभी आवश्यकताएं पूरी होती हैं।
back: Employees are required to provide FMLA leave where all requirements are met.

en: A family member of a covered servicemember may take up to 26 workweeks of leave to care for the servicemember.
bad_en: A covered servicemember may take up to 26 workweeks of leave to care for a family member.
translation: कवर किए गए सेवा सदस्य के परिवार का कोई सदस्य सेवा सदस्य की देखभाल के लिए 26 कार्य सप्ताह तक की छुट्टी ले सकता है।
back: A family member of a covered service member may take up to 26 work weeks of leave to care for the service member.

en: A family member of a covered servicemember may take up to 26 workweeks of leave to care for the servicemember.
bad_en: A covered servicemember may take up to 26 workweeks of leave to care for a family member.
translation: परिवार के किसी सदस्य की देखभाल के लिए कवर किया गया सेवा सदस्य 26 कार्य सप्ताह तक की छुट्टी ले सकता है।
back: A covered service member may take up to 26 work weeks of leave to care for a family member.

en: Furnishers must investigate and respond to your dispute within 30 days.
bad_en: You must investigate and respond to the furnisher's dispute within 30 days.
translation: फर्निशर्स को 30 दिनों के भीतर आपके विवाद की जांच करनी होगी और जवाब देना होगा।
back: Furnishers must investigate and respond to your dispute within 30 days.

en: Furnishers must investigate and respond to your dispute within 30 days.
bad_en: You must investigate and respond to the furnisher's dispute within 30 days.
translation: आपको 30 दिनों के भीतर फर्निचर के विवाद की जांच करनी होगी और जवाब देना होगा।
back: You must investigate and respond to the furniture dispute within 30 days.

en: The furnisher must update or remove the information and notify all the credit reporting companies.
bad_en: The credit reporting companies must update or remove the information and notify the furnisher.
translation: फर्निशर को जानकारी अपडेट करनी होगी या हटानी होगी और सभी क्रेडिट रिपोर्टिंग कंपनियों को सूचित करना होगा।
back: The furnisher must update or delete the information and notify all credit reporting companies.

en: The furnisher must update or remove the information and notify all the credit reporting companies.
bad_en: The credit reporting companies must update or remove the information and notify the furnisher.
translation: क्रेडिट रिपोर्टिंग कंपनियों को जानकारी को अद्यतन करना होगा या हटाना होगा और प्रस्तुतकर्ता को सूचित करना होगा।
back: Credit reporting companies must update or delete the information and notify the submitter.

en: The credit reporting companies must update your credit reports.
bad_en: You must update the credit reporting companies' records.
translation: क्रेडिट रिपोर्टिंग कंपनियों को आपकी क्रेडिट रिपोर्ट अपडेट करनी होगी।
back: Credit reporting companies are required to update your credit report.

en: The credit reporting companies must update your credit reports.
bad_en: You must update the credit reporting companies' records.
translation: आपको क्रेडिट रिपोर्टिंग कंपनियों के रिकॉर्ड को अपडेट करना होगा।
back: You will need to update the records of the credit reporting companies.

en: The items inside the secure bags must be screened and cleared by TSA.
bad_en: The items inside the secure bags must be screened and cleared by the passenger.
translation: सुरक्षित बैग के अंदर की वस्तुओं की टीएसए द्वारा जांच और सफाई की जानी चाहिए।
back: Items inside secured bags must be examined and cleaned by TSA.

en: The items inside the secure bags must be screened and cleared by TSA.
bad_en: The items inside the secure bags must be screened and cleared by the passenger.
translation: सुरक्षित बैग के अंदर की वस्तुओं की यात्री द्वारा जांच और सफाई की जानी चाहिए।
back: Items inside the secured bag must be checked and cleaned by the passenger.

en: If the downgraded passenger continues to travel, the airline must refund the fare difference to the passenger.
bad_en: If the downgraded passenger continues to travel, the passenger must pay the fare difference to the airline.
translation: यदि डाउनग्रेड किया गया यात्री यात्रा करना जारी रखता है, तो एयरलाइन को यात्री को किराए का अंतर वापस करना होगा।
back: If the downgraded passenger continues to travel, the airline must refund the difference in fare to the passenger.

en: If the downgraded passenger continues to travel, the airline must refund the fare difference to the passenger.
bad_en: If the downgraded passenger continues to travel, the passenger must pay the fare difference to the airline.
translation: यदि डाउनग्रेड किया गया यात्री यात्रा करना जारी रखता है, तो यात्री को एयरलाइन को किराए के अंतर का भुगतान करना होगा।
back: If the downgraded passenger continues to travel, the passenger must pay the difference in fare to the airline.

en: You must keep records for 3 years.
bad_en: The IRS keeps your records for 3 years.
translation: आपको 3 साल तक रिकॉर्ड रखना होगा।
back: You will have to keep records for 3 years.

en: You must keep records for 3 years.
bad_en: The IRS keeps your records for 3 years.
translation: आईआरएस आपका रिकॉर्ड 3 साल तक रखता है।
back: The IRS keeps your records for 3 years.

en: You can renew your passport by mail if it was issued when you were 16 or older.
bad_en: Your parent must renew your passport by mail if it was issued when you were 16 or older.
translation: आप अपना पासपोर्ट मेल द्वारा नवीनीकृत कर सकते हैं यदि यह तब जारी किया गया था जब आप 16 वर्ष या उससे अधिक उम्र के थे।
back: You can renew your passport by mail if it was issued when you were 16 or older.

en: You can renew your passport by mail if it was issued when you were 16 or older.
bad_en: Your parent must renew your passport by mail if it was issued when you were 16 or older.
translation: यदि आपके पासपोर्ट को आपके 16 वर्ष या उससे अधिक उम्र में जारी किया गया था, तो आपके माता-पिता को मेल द्वारा आपका पासपोर्ट नवीनीकृत करना होगा।
back: If your passport was issued when you were 16 or older, your parents must renew your passport by mail.

en: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 20 seconds before and after handling raw chicken.
bad_en: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 5 seconds before and after handling raw chicken.
translation: Lavez-vous les mains à l'eau et au savon pendant au moins 20 secondes avant et après avoir manipulé du poulet cru.
back: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 20 seconds before and after handling raw chicken.

en: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 20 seconds before and after handling raw chicken.
bad_en: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 5 seconds before and after handling raw chicken.
translation: Lavez-vous les mains à l’eau et au savon pendant au moins 5 secondes avant et après avoir manipulé du poulet cru.
back: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 5 seconds before and after handling raw chicken.

en: Never leave perishable food out for more than 2 hours.
bad_en: Never leave perishable food out for more than 4 hours.
translation: Ne laissez jamais de denrées périssables dehors pendant plus de 2 heures.
back: Never leave perishable foods outside for more than 2 hours.

en: Never leave perishable food out for more than 2 hours.
bad_en: Never leave perishable food out for more than 4 hours.
translation: Ne laissez jamais de denrées périssables dehors pendant plus de 4 heures.
back: Never leave perishable foods outside for more than 4 hours.

en: If the food is exposed to temperatures above 90°F, like a hot car or picnic, refrigerate it within 1 hour.
bad_en: If the food is exposed to temperatures above 90°F, like a hot car or picnic, refrigerate it within 3 hours.
translation: Si les aliments sont exposés à des températures supérieures à 90 °F, comme une voiture chaude ou un pique-nique, réfrigérez-les dans l'heure.
back: If food is exposed to temperatures above 90°F, such as a hot car or a picnic, refrigerate it within an hour.

en: If the food is exposed to temperatures above 90°F, like a hot car or picnic, refrigerate it within 1 hour.
bad_en: If the food is exposed to temperatures above 90°F, like a hot car or picnic, refrigerate it within 3 hours.
translation: Si les aliments sont exposés à des températures supérieures à 90°F, comme une voiture chaude ou un pique-nique, réfrigérez-les dans les 3 heures.
back: If food is exposed to temperatures above 90°F, such as a hot car or a picnic, refrigerate it within 3 hours.

en: Keep your refrigerator at 40°F or below and your freezer at 0°F or below.
bad_en: Keep your refrigerator at 50°F or below and your freezer at 0°F or below.
translation: Gardez votre réfrigérateur à 40°F ou moins et votre congélateur à 0°F ou moins.
back: Keep your refrigerator at 40°F or lower and your freezer at 0°F or lower.

en: Keep your refrigerator at 40°F or below and your freezer at 0°F or below.
bad_en: Keep your refrigerator at 50°F or below and your freezer at 0°F or below.
translation: Gardez votre réfrigérateur à 50°F ou moins et votre congélateur à 0°F ou moins.
back: Keep your refrigerator at 50°F or lower and your freezer at 0°F or lower.

translation: اگر آپ کا پاسپورٹ 15 سال سے زیادہ پہلے جاری ہوا ہے تو آپ بذریعہ ڈاک تجدید کر سکتے ہیں۔
back: If your passport was issued more than 15 years ago, you can renew by post.

en: The receipt must show the purchase was made within the last 48 hours.
bad_en: The receipt must show the purchase was made more than 48 hours ago.
translation: رسید میں یہ ظاہر ہونا چاہیے کہ خریداری گزشتہ 48 گھنٹوں کے اندر کی گئی تھی۔
back: The receipt must show that the purchase was made within the last 48 hours.

en: The receipt must show the purchase was made within the last 48 hours.
bad_en: The receipt must show the purchase was made more than 48 hours ago.
translation: رسید میں یہ ظاہر ہونا چاہیے کہ خریداری 48 گھنٹے سے زیادہ پہلے کی گئی تھی۔
back: The receipt must show that the purchase was made more than 48 hours ago.

en: You are entitled to a refund if the airline cancelled your flight and you choose not to travel.
bad_en: You are entitled to a refund if the airline cancelled your flight or you choose not to travel.
translation: اگر ایئر لائن نے آپ کی پرواز منسوخ کردی اور آپ سفر نہ کرنے کا انتخاب کرتے ہیں تو آپ رقم کی واپسی کے حقدار ہیں۔
back: If the airline cancels your flight and you choose not to travel, you are entitled to a refund.

en: You are entitled to a refund if the airline cancelled your flight and you choose not to travel.
bad_en: You are entitled to a refund if the airline cancelled your flight or you choose not to travel.
translation: اگر ایئر لائن نے آپ کی پرواز منسوخ کردی یا آپ سفر نہ کرنے کا انتخاب کرتے ہیں تو آپ رقم کی واپسی کے حقدار ہیں۔
back: If the airline cancels your flight or you choose not to travel, you are entitled to a refund.

en: If you chose to take a significantly delayed flight, you are not entitled to a refund.
bad_en: Unless you chose to take a significantly delayed flight, you are not entitled to a refund.
translation: اگر آپ نے نمایاں طور پر تاخیر سے پرواز لینے کا انتخاب کیا ہے، تو آپ رقم کی واپسی کے حقدار نہیں ہیں۔
back: If you choose to take a significantly delayed flight, you are not entitled to a refund.

en: If you chose to take a significantly delayed flight, you are not entitled to a refund.
bad_en: Unless you chose to take a significantly delayed flight, you are not entitled to a refund.
translation: جب تک آپ نے خاصی تاخیر سے پرواز لینے کا انتخاب نہیں کیا، آپ رقم کی واپسی کے حقدار نہیں ہیں۔
back: Unless you have chosen to take a significantly delayed flight, you are not entitled to a refund.

en: If the downgraded passenger continues to travel, the airline must refund the difference between the original fare and the lower fare.
bad_en: Unless the downgraded passenger continues to travel, the airline must refund the difference between the original fare and the lower fare.
translation: اگر نیچے گرا ہوا مسافر سفر جاری رکھتا ہے، تو ایئر لائن کو اصل کرایہ اور کم کرایہ کے درمیان فرق کو واپس کرنا ہوگا۔
back: If the downgraded passenger continues the journey, the airline must refund the difference between the original fare and the reduced fare.

en: If the downgraded passenger continues to travel, the airline must refund the difference between the original fare and the lower fare.
bad_en: Unless the downgraded passenger continues to travel, the airline must refund the difference between the original fare and the lower fare.
translation: جب تک نیچے گرا ہوا مسافر سفر جاری نہیں رکھتا، ایئر لائن کو اصل کرایہ اور کم کرایہ کے درمیان فرق کو واپس کرنا ہوگا۔
back: As long as the downgraded passenger does not continue the journey, the airline must refund the difference between the original fare and the reduced fare.

en: Passengers can get their bag fee refunded if the bag is not delivered within 12 hours.
bad_en: Passengers can get their bag fee refunded unless the bag is not delivered within 12 hours.
translation: اگر 12 گھنٹے کے اندر بیگ کی ڈیلیوری نہیں ہوتی ہے تو مسافر اپنے بیگ کی فیس واپس کر سکتے ہیں۔
back: If the bag is not delivered within 12 hours, passengers can refund their bag fee.

en: Passengers can get their bag fee refunded if the bag is not delivered within 12 hours.
bad_en: Passengers can get their bag fee refunded unless the bag is not delivered within 12 hours.
translation: مسافر اپنے بیگ کی فیس واپس حاصل کر سکتے ہیں جب تک کہ بیگ 12 گھنٹے کے اندر نہیں پہنچایا جاتا۔
back: Passengers can get their bag fee back as long as the bag is not delivered within 12 hours.

en: To be eligible, employees must have at least 1,250 hours of service and work at a location with at least 50 employees within 75 miles.
bad_en: To be eligible, employees must have at least 1,250 hours of service or work at a location with at least 50 employees within 75 miles.
translation: اہل ہونے کے لیے، ملازمین کے پاس کم از کم 1,250 گھنٹے سروس ہونی چاہیے اور 75 میل کے اندر کم از کم 50 ملازمین کے ساتھ ایک جگہ پر کام کرنا چاہیے۔
back: To qualify, employees must have at least 1,250 hours of service and work at a location with at least 50 employees within 75 miles.

en: To be eligible, employees must have at least 1,250 hours of service and work at a location with at least 50 employees within 75 miles.
bad_en: To be eligible, employees must have at least 1,250 hours of service or work at a location with at least 50 employees within 75 miles.

back: To qualify, employees must have at least 1,250 hours of service or work at a location with at least 50 employees within 75 miles.

en: An employee may not take intermittent leave for the birth of a child unless the employer agrees.
bad_en: An employee may not take intermittent leave for the birth of a child if the employer agrees.
translation: ایک ملازم بچے کی پیدائش کے لیے وقفے وقفے سے چھٹی نہیں لے سکتا جب تک کہ آجر راضی نہ ہو۔
back: An employee cannot take maternity leave unless the employer agrees.

en: An employee may not take intermittent leave for the birth of a child unless the employer agrees.
bad_en: An employee may not take intermittent leave for the birth of a child if the employer agrees.
translation: اگر آجر راضی ہو تو ملازم بچے کی پیدائش کے لیے وقفے وقفے سے چھٹی نہیں لے سکتا۔
back: An employee cannot take intermittent leave for childbirth if the employer agrees.

en: Keep records for 7 years if you file a claim for a loss from worthless securities.
bad_en: Keep records for 7 years unless you file a claim for a loss from worthless securities.
translation: اگر آپ بیکار سیکیورٹیز سے نقصان کا دعویٰ دائر کرتے ہیں تو 7 سال تک ریکارڈ رکھیں۔

en: Keep records for 7 years if you file a claim for a loss from worthless securities.

bad_en: Keep records indefinitely unless you do not file a return.
translation: اگر آپ ریٹرن فائل نہیں کرتے ہیں تو غیر معینہ مدت تک ریکارڈ رکھیں۔

back: Keep the records indefinitely until you file a return.

en: If the information cannot be verified, the furnisher must update or remove it.

translation: اگر معلومات کی تصدیق نہیں کی جا سکتی ہے، تو فرنیشر کو اسے اپ ڈیٹ یا ہٹا دینا چاہیے۔

en: Keep employment tax records for 4 years after the date the tax becomes due or is paid, whichever is later.
bad_en: Keep employment tax records for 4 years after the date the tax becomes due and is paid.
translation: ٹیکس واجب الادا ہونے یا ادا ہونے کی تاریخ کے بعد 4 سال تک ملازمت کے ٹیکس کے ریکارڈ رکھیں، جو بھی بعد میں ہو۔
back: Keep employment tax records for 4 years after the date the tax is due or paid, whichever is later.

back: Keep employment tax records for 4 years after the date the tax is due and paid.

en: A refund is due within 20 calendar days if you paid with another form of payment, such as a check or cash.
bad_en: A refund is due within 20 calendar days unless you paid with another form of payment, such as a check or cash.
translation: اگر آپ نے ادائیگی کی دوسری شکل، جیسے کہ چیک یا نقدی سے ادائیگی کی تو 20 کیلنڈر دنوں کے اندر رقم کی واپسی واجب الادا ہے۔
back: If you paid with another form of payment, such as check or cash, a refund is due within 20 calendar days.

bad_en: A refund is due within 20 calendar days unless you paid with another form of payment, such as a check or cash.
translation: رقم کی واپسی 20 کیلنڈر دنوں کے اندر واجب الادا ہے جب تک کہ آپ ادائیگی کی دوسری شکل، جیسے کہ چیک یا نقد رقم سے ادائیگی کرتے ہیں۔
back: Refunds are due within 20 calendar days unless you paid with another form of payment, such as check or cash.

bad_en: Passengers must pay the airline back within seven business days for credit card purchases.
translation: ایئر لائنز کو کریڈٹ کارڈ کی خریداری کے لیے سات کاروباری دنوں کے اندر ریفنڈ جاری کرنا چاہیے۔
back: Airlines must issue refunds for credit card purchases within seven business days.

back: Passengers must repay the airline within seven business days for credit card purchases.

en: Employees must communicate with their employer about their leave needs.

back: Employers should communicate with their employees about their leave needs.

back: A covered service member's family member may take up to 26 work weeks of leave to care for the service member.

en: A family member of a covered servicemember may take up to 26 workweeks of leave to care for the servicemember.
